Mishneh Torah, Borrowing and Deposit 3:
Hashoel et happara mechavero ushelachah lo hammashil beyad beno o beyad shelucho o beyad avdo. afillu shelachah lo beyad beno o beyad avdo o beyad shelucho shel shoel umeta kodem shettikkanes lirshut hashshoel hare ze patur. veim amar lo hashshoel shallechah li beyad beni beyad avdi beyad sheluchi o beyad avdecha haivri o beyad sheluchacha. o sheamar lo hammashil hareni meshallechah beyad bincha beyad avdecha beyad sheluchacha beyad beni beyad avdi haivri beyad sheluchi. veamar lo hashshoel shelach ushelachah umeta badderech hare ze chayyav. shelachah lo hammashil beyad avdo hakkenaani af al pi sheamar lo hashshoel shelach umeta patur mippene sheyyado keyad rabbo vaadayin lo yatza mershut hammashil: 
Amar lo hashshoel hakkishah bemakkel vehi tavo meeleha veasa hammashil kach en hashshoel chayyav bah ad shettikkanes lirshuto. aval meta badderech patur. vechen beshaa shemmachzirah hashshoel labbealim im shelachah beyad acher umeta kodem shettaggia lirshut hammashil hare ze chayyav sheadayin hi beacharayut hashshoel. veim shelachah middaat hammashil al yede acher umeta patur. shelachah beyad avdo hakkenaani af al pi sheamar lo hammashil shelach im meta badderech chayyav sheyyad haeved keyad rabbo vaadayin lo yatzat miyyad hashshoel. bamme devarim amurim beshehechzirah betoch yeme sheilatah. aval im hechezirah achar yeme sheilatah hare ze patur im meta badderech sheachar yeme sheelatah yatzata middin sheela vahare hu keshomer sachar. lefichach im nishbet o meta achare yeme sheilatah patur. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hashshoel para mechavero. shealah chatzi hayyom usecharah chatzi hayyom. shealah hayyom usecharah lemachar. shaal achat vesachar achat umeta achat mehen. hammashil omer sheula meta bayyom shehayta sheula meta bashshaa shehayta sheula meta vehashshomer omer eni yodea. o sheamar hashshoel sechura meta bayyom shehayta sechura meta bashshaa shehayta sechura meta. vehammashil omer eni yodea o sheamar ze eni yodea veze omer eni yodea. hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. lo hayta sham reaya yishshava hassocher al hassechura shemmeta o sheeno yodea veyippater. ze omer sheula veze omer sechura yishshava hashshomer al hassechura shemmeta kedarkah kemo shettaan vigalgel alav shehassechura hi shemmeta: 
Hishilo shete parot chatzi hayyom bishela vachatzi hayyom bischirut. hammashil omer bizman hashsheela meta vehalla omer achat meta bizman hashsheela vehaacheret eni yodea. mittoch sheeno yachol lishshava yeshallem hashshetayim. vechen im masar lo shalosh parot shetayim sheulot veachat sechura. hammashil omer shetayim hashsheulot hen shemmetu vehashshoel omer achat hashsheula meta vadday aval hashsheniyya shemmeta eni yodea im hashsheula haacheret o hassechura. mittoch sheeno yachol lishshava shehare omer eni yodea yeshallem hashshetayim. uvehilchot toen venitan yitbaer din ze vechayyotze bo mikkol hattoanin sheenan yecholim lehishshava vechetzad meshallemin umee ze taam hem meshallemim:
Mishneh Torah, Borrowing and Deposit 4:
Hammafkid etzel chavero bechinnam venignav o avad hare ze nishba veniftar shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 6)</small> "vegunnav mibbet haish" vegomer <small>(Shemot 22 7)</small> "venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu". umegalgelin alav betoch hashshevua shello pasha ella shamar kederech hashshomrin velo shalach bo yad veachar nignav. sheim nignav achar sheshshalach yad bappikkadon chayyav beacharayuto: 
Hoil ufatar hakkatuv et shomer chinnam min haggeneva kal vachomer min hoonasin haggedolim kegon shevura ushevuya umeta vehu shello shalach yad bappikkadon aval shalach yad bappikkadon chayyav beonasav. ketzad derech hashshomrim. hakkol lefi happikkadon. yesh pikkadon shedderech shemirato lehannicho bevet shaar kegon hakkorot vehaavanim. veyesh pikkadon shedderech shemirato lehannicho bechatzer kegon chavilot pishtan haggedolot vechayyotze bahen. veyesh pikkadon shedderech shemirato lehannicho babbayit kegon simla vetallit. veyesh pikkadon shedderech shemirato lehannicho beteva o bemigdal venoel alav kegon bigde meshi uchele kesef uchele zahav vechayyotze bahen: 
Hashshomer shehinniach happikkadon bemakom sheeno rauy lo venignav mishsham o avad afillu neenas sham kegon shennafla deleka vesaraf kol habbayit hare ze poshea vechayyav leshallem. veaf al pi shehinniach happikkadon im shello im rauy lishmira patur veim en hammakom rauy lishmira chayyav. beshello hu rashshay veeno rashshay beshel acherim: 
Hakkesafim vehaddinarin en lahem shemira ella bakkarka veyitten alehem tefach afar. o yitmenem bakkotel battefach hassamuch lakkora. aval lo beemtza hakkotel shemma yachperu haggannavim sham veyignevu. afillu naal alehem karauy beteva o hechbi otam bemakom sheen adam makkiro velo margish bo hare ze poshea vechayyav leshallem. horu miktzat hammevinim shehu haddin lechol davar shemmassao kal veen hakkarka meabbedet oto bimhera kegon leshonot shel kesef veen tzarich lomar leshonot shel zahav vaavanim tovot sheen lahem shemira ella bakkarka. velaze dati note: 
Hammafkid etzel chavero kesafim erev shabbat ben hashshemashot eno chayyav litroach velikbor otan ad motzae shabbat. veim nitacher lemotzae shabbat kede lekavran velo kevaran venignevu o neensu chayyav. veim talmid chacham hu eno chayyav ad sheyyishhe achar sheyyavdil kede lekavran: 
Hifkid etzel chavero kesafim badderech leholicham leveto o sheshshalach immo maot mimmakom lemakom tzerichin sheyyihyu tzerurim umunnachim beyado o keshurim karauy al bitno mikkeneged panav ad sheyyaggia leveto veyikberem karauy. veim lo kesharan badderech hazzot afillu neensu chayyav leshallem shehare techillato bifshia. maase beechad shehifkid maot etzel chavero vehinnicham bimchitztza shel kanim vehayu temunim boovi hammechitztza venignevu mishsham veamru chachamim af al pi shezzo shemira meulla leinyan geneva enah shemira karauy leinyan haesh umeachar shello temano bekarka o bechotel binyan poshea hu vechol shettechillato bifshia vesofo beones chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hammafkid etzel chavero ben kelim ben maot veamar lo ten li pikdoni veamar lo hashshomer eni yodea anna hinnachti pikkadon ze o bee ze makom kavarti hakkesafim hameten li ad sheavakkesh veemtza veachzir lecha hare ze poshea vechayyav leshallem miyyad: 
Kol hammafkid etzel baal habbayit ben kelim ben maot al daat ishto uvanav uvene beto haggedolim hu mafkid. aval im mesaran levanav uvene beto hakketannim o laavadav ben gedolim ben ketannim o leechad mikkerovav sheenan sheruyin immo babbayit veen somchin al shulchano veen tzarich lomar im mesaran leacher hare ze poshea vechayyav leshallem ella im ken hevi hashshomer hashsheni reaya shello pasha kemo shebbearnu. maase beechad shehifkid maot etzel chavero unetanam hashshomer leimmo vehechbia otan velo tamna otan venignevu veamru chachamim en hashshomer chayyav leshallem mippene shennetanam leimmo shekkol hammafkid al daat banav uvene beto hu mafkid veaf al pi shello amar lah pikkadon hem yesh lo liton kol shekken shehi nizheret bahen im hayta sevura shehen shelli. vechen en immo chayyevet leshallem shehare lo amar lah shehen pikkadon. veamru chachamim yishshava hashshomer sheotan hammaot atzman hen shennetanan leimmo vetishshava haem shehechbia otan venignevu veyippatru shenehem. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mikkan atta lamed shehashshomer shemmasar happikkadon leishto uvene beto vehodian shehu pikkadon velo shamru kederech hashshomrin shehen chayyavin leshallem levaal happikkadon uvaal habbayit patur shekkol hammafkid al daat ishto uvanav hu mafkid. maase beechad shehifkid keshut etzel echad vehaya lo lashshomer keshut acheret veamar leshammasho mizze hakkeshut tashlich letoch hashshechar vehalach hashshammash vehishlich mikkeshut shel pikkadon. amru chachamim shehashshammash patur shehare lo amar mizze hashelech umizze al tashlech vedimma shehu mare makom veeno makpid al ze. vechen baal habbayit patur shehare amar lo mizze hashelech veeno meshallem ella deme ma shennehena bilvad. lefichach im naasa hashshechar chometz patur milleshallem. uven kach uven kach chayyav hashshomer shevua shekkach era. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Borrowing and Deposit 5:
Mi shehifkidu etzlo maot shel aniyyim o shel pidyon shevuyim ufasha bahem venignevu patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 6)</small> "lishmor" velo lechallek laaniyyim vahare hu mamon sheen lo tovim. afillu bau alav gannavim vekadam vehitztzil atzmo bemamon shevuyim patur. en lecha pidyon shevuyim gadol mizze. bamme devarim amurim besheen ze hammamon mufkad laaniyye makom ze o lishvuyim [ellu]. aval im hayu laaniyyim ellu o lishvuyim ellu vahare hu katzutz lahen hare ze hammamon sheyyesh lo tovin vishallem im pasha o yishshava shello pasha kederech kol hashshomrim: 
Hammafkid etzel chavero mamon o kelim chashuvin uvau alav gannavim vekadam venatan lahem happikkadon lehatztzil atzmo im haya amud shehu baal mamon chayyav shechezkato shebbiglalo bau haggannavim venimtza ze matztzil atzmo bemamon chavero. veim eno amud chezkato shello bau ella leshem happikkadon ufatur. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hammafkid etzel chavero kelim o perot uvau gannavim ugenavum befanav veillu haya tzoveach hayu bain bene adam umatztzilin otan hoil velo tzavach hare ze poshea vechayyav leshallem. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shenayim shehifkidu etzel echad ze mea veze matayim vechol echad mishshenehem omer ani hu shehifkadti hammatayim vehashshomer omer eni yodea yishshava kol echad mehen shehifkid matayim venotel kedin kol nishba venotel. veyitten matayim laze umatayim laze umafsid mea mibbeto shehare hu poshea shehaya lo lichtov shem kol echad al kis shello. lefichach im heviu lo hashshenayim keechad shelosh meot becherech echad uvau vetavu vechol echad omer hammatayim shelli noten mane laze umane laze vehashshear yihye munnach etzlo ad leolam o ad sheyyode haechad lachavero. shehare hu omer lahem kevan sheraiti sheen attem makpidin ze al ze vahavetem becherech echad lo hitrachti atzmi leda velizkor tamid mi baal hammea umi baal hammatayim. vechen im hifkidu etzlo shene kelim echad gadol veechad katan vechol echad veechad omer ani hu baal haggadol vehashshomer omer eni yodea yishshavu shenehem veyitten haggadol leechad mehem udeme haggadol lashsheni veyishshaer lo hakkatan. veim hevium becherech echad keechad noten hakkatan laechad udeme hakkatan lashsheni vehashshear yihye munnach etzlo ad sheyyode haechad lachavero o ad leolam. vechen mi shettevauhu shenayim ze omer ani hu baal happikkadon veze omer ani hu vehashshomer omer echad mikkem hu veeni yodea mi hu yeshallem lishnehem. vechen shenayim shehifkidu shete behemot etzel roe umeta achat mehen veeno yodea shel mi hayta yeshallem lishnehem. veim hifkidu beedro shello middato manniach habbehema benehem umistallek vetihye munnachat ad sheyyode haechad lachavero o ad sheyyirtzu lachalok otah: 
Hammafkid perot etzel chavero hare ze lo yearvem im perotav. avar veerev yachshov kamma haya happikkadon veyire kamma chaser hakkol veyachshov chesron happikkadon veyitten lo achar sheyyishshava. nistappek mehen velo yada kamma nistappek yotzi lo chesrono lechittim uleorez kaluf arbaa kabbin umechetza lechol kor. lisorim uledochan tisha kabbin lechol kor. lechussemin ulezera pishtan begivolav uleorez sheeno kaluf shalosh sein lechol kor. vechammidda hazzot lechol shana veshana. bamme devarim amurim shemmadad lo bimot haggoren vehechezir lo bimot haggoren. aval madad bimot haggoren vehechzir lo bimot haggeshamim eno motzi lo chesrono mippene shehen motirot. vechen motzi lo shetut leyayin usheloshet login shemen lemea login log umechetza shemarim velog umechetza bela. im haya mezukkak eno motzi lo shemarim. veim hayu hakkankannim yeshanim eno motzi lo bela: 
Hifkid etzlo perot sheenan medudin veervan im perotav velo medadan hare ze poshea. baal happikkadon omer kach vechach hayu vehashshomer omer eni yodea yeshallem belo shevua shehare chiyyev atzmo betashlumin veeno yodea kamma hu chayyav venimtza chayyav shevua sheeno yachol lehishshava. vechaze horu rabbotay harav rabbenu yosef hallevi verabbo zichrono livracha. vechen kol shomer shennitchayyev leshallem veamar eni yodea kamma damim ani chayyav leshallem vehabbealim omrim anu yodin vechach vechach haya shave yittelu belo shevua vehu sheyyitanu davar shehen amudin bo. veyesh lashshomer lehacharim al mi shellakach mimmennu yeter min harauy lo. uminnayin shehaddin kach hu hagga atzmecha shehifkid etzlo kis male zehuvim ufasha bo habbealim omrim matayim dinar hayu vehashshomer omer vadday shehaya bo dinarim aval eni yodea kamma hayu nimtza ze ketoen matayim vehoda lo bemiktzat veamar hashshear eni yodea shehu mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava umeshallem kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Met aviv vehinniach lo sak tzarur vehifkido etzlo chavero ufasha bo hammafkid omer eni yodea me hayu bo shemma margaliyyot hayu bo vechen hashshomer omer eni yodea kamma ani chayyav leshallem shemma zechuchit haya male. shurat haddin sheani omer betaana zo sheyyishshava hashshomer betakkanat chachamim sheeno birshuto veyichlol bishvuato sheeno yodea bevadday shehaya bo yeter al sheve kach vechach vishallem ma shehoda bo. vechen kol kayyotze baze. maase beechad shehifkid sak tzarur etzel chavero ufasha bo. hammafkid omer chali zahav umargaliyyot vechayyotze bahen hayu bo vehashshomer omer eni yodea shemma sigim o chol hayu bo. veamru chachamim yishshava baal happikkadon veyittol vehu sheyyiton davar shehu amud bo o amud lehafekido etzlo. velamma nishba kan baal happikkadon lefi sheen hashshomer mechuyyav shevua sheafillu hoda veamar bari li shehaya male sigim vehammafkid omer margaliyyot hayu hashshomer nishba hesset veniftar kemo shetteano chittim vehoda lo bisorim. vechen kol kayyotze baze. uvehilchot toen venitan yitbaaru ikkere haddevarim:
Mishneh Torah, Borrowing and Deposit 6:
Shomer chinnam sheamar hareni meshallem veeni nishba im happikkadon davar shekkol mino shave umatzuy bashshuk liknot kemoto kegon perot o yeriot shel tzemer veshel pishtan hashshavot bechol inyanam o korot sheenan metzuyyarot vechol kayyotze bahen hare ze meshallem veeno nishba. aval im haya pikdon behema o beged metzuyyar o keli metukkan o davar sheeno motze liknot kemoto bashshuk choshshin shemma enav natan bo umashbiin oto betakkanat chachamim shevua binkitat chefetz sheeno birshuto veachar kach meshallem. vehu haddin lishar hashshomrin kegon hashshoel sheamar meta o nigneva veshomer sachar vehassocher sheamar nigneva o sheavda af al pi shehen chayyavin leshallem mashbiin otan shevua sheenah birshutan veachar kach meshallemin deme habbehema o hachefetz sheanu choshshin lo shemma enav natan bah. veim amru habbealim yeter al ze haya shave kolel bishvuato sheenah shava ella kach vechach. nimtza kol shomer shennishba shevuat hashshomrin kolel bishvuato shelosha devarim. sheshshamar kederech hashshomrin. vesheero kach vechach veeno birshuto. veshello shalach bo yad kodem sheero hameora happoter oto. veim ratza leshallem nishba sheeno birshuto vecholel bishvuato shekkach vechach haya shave: 
Yesh lashshomer lehatenot sheeno shomer kederech hashshomrin ella maot ellu shehifkid etzli bezavit beti ani manniach otan vechayyotze baze. taan hashshomer shettenay haya benenu uvaal happikkadon omer lo haya sham tenay af al pi shehifkid etzlo beedim mittoch sheyyachol lomar shamarti kederech hashshomrin veneenasti neeman lomar shehaya benehen tenay lefichach yishshava shello shalach yad bo vesheeno birshuto veshehaya benehen tenay: 
Shomer chinnam shehevi reaya shello pasha bah patur mishshevua veen omrim shemma shalach bo yad kodem sheyyovad. uvaal happikkadon shehevi reaya sheppasha hashshomer meshallem. veim taan veamar tenay haya benenu eno neeman shehare yesh edim sheppasha: 
Hifkid etzel chavero beedim uvau edim shezze hachefetz befanenu hifkido etzlo en hashshomer yachol liton velomar chazarti ulekachtiv mimmennu o netano li bemattana. lefichach im met hashshomer motziin happikkadon atzmo min hayetomim belo shevua. velo od ella mi shebba veamar kach vechach hifkadti etzel avichem venatan simanin muvhakin venimtza happikkadon kemo sheamar vehaya yodea haddayyan shello haya hammet amud shezze happikkadon shello. yesh lo laddayyan hazze latet happikkadon leze shennatan simanav. vehu shello yihye hammafkid ragil lehikkanes etzel ze shemmet aval im haya ragil likkanes etzlo shemma shel acher hu vehikkir hassimanin shello. bau edim veheidu laddayyan sheen ze amud en motziin miyyad hayetomim beedutan sheen ze reaya berura veumdan datan eno omed dato veen lo laddayyan ella ma sheddato somechet alav kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot sanhedrin. maase beechad shehifkid shumshemin etzel chavero beedim uva letavo veamar lo hechzartim. amar lo hammafkid vahalo kach vechach hi middatam vahare hem munnachim etzlecha bechavitcha. amar lo shellecha hechzarti lecha veellu acherim hen. veamru chachamim en motziin miyyado shemma ellu hashshumshemin shel shomer hen ella yishshava hashshomer binkitat chefetz shehechzir kemo shebbearnu: 
Baal happikkadon shettava pikdono venatan lo hashshomer veamar hammafkid en ze pikdoni ella acher hu o shalem haya veatta shevarto o chadash haya venishtammashta bo. mea sein hifkadti etzlecha veen ellu ella chamishshim uvaal habbayit omer zehu shehifkadta beatzmecha uma shennatatta atta notel. hare hashshomer nishba hesset kishar kol hannishbain sheen kol shomer nishba shevuat hashshomrin haamura battora ella bizman shemmode beatzmo shel pikkadon kemo shehammafkid omer vetoen shennignav o met o nishba. kelalo shel davar toen liftor atzmo min hattashlumin [nishba shevuat shomrin]. aval im amar zehu shehishaltani o shehiskarta li o shennatalti sachar al shemirati vehabbealim omrim eno ze ella acher o nishtanna mikkemot shehaya hassocher nishba hesset o shevuat hattora im hoda bemiktzat. ketzad. mea sea hifkadti etzlecha vehashshomer omer lo hifkadta etzli ella chamishshim nishba shevuat hattora mippene shehoda bemiktzat lo mishshum shevuat hashshomrin. mea kor shel chittim hifkadti etzlecha vehu omer lo hifkadta etzli ella mea shel seorim nishba hesset kishar kol hannishbain betaana kazo:
Mishneh Torah, Borrowing and Deposit 7:
Hammafkid perot etzel chavero hare ze lo yigga bahen veaf al pi shehen chosrin umitmaatin veholchin. bamme devarim amurim keshechasru chissaron harauy lahen bechol shana. aval im chasru yoter mikkede chesronan mochran bevet din mippene shehu meshiv aveda labbealim. ucheshehu mochran yimkor lakkohanim bidme teruma shemma asu otan habbealim teruma o terumat maaser al perot acherot: 
Hammafkid etzel chavero perot vehirkivu devash venifsad yayin vehechmitz ose takkana levaal happikkadon umochran bevet din af al pi sheamdu behefsedan veen hahefsed pose bahen hare hakkankannim vehassallim mosifin hefsed: 
Hammafkid chametz etzel chavero vehiggia happesach hare ze lo yigga bo ad shaa chamishit miyyom arbaa asar. mikkan veelach yotze umochro bashshuk lishato mishshum heshshev aveda labbealim. vehu haddin lishar happikdonot shello yigga bahen af al pi shehu yodea bevadday sheyyizzolu bizman peloni o yeenos otam hammelech shemma yavo baalehen mikkodem veyittelu mamonam: 
Hammafkid sefer tora etzel chavero gollo paam achat lishnem asar chodesh. veim keshehu gollo potcho vekara bo muttar. aval lo yiftach biglal atzmo veyikra. vehu haddin shear sefarim. veim patach vekara vegalal biglal atzmo hare shalach yad bappikkadon venitchayyev boonasin. hifkid etzlo kesut shel tzemer menaneah achat lishloshim yom kederech sheamru baaveda kach amru bappikkadon. vechen kol kayyotze baze shezzo chova alav mishshum heshshev aveda labbealim. bamme devarim amurim befikkadon shehalchu bealav limdinat hayyam aval im hayu immo beotah haaretz hare ze lo yigga bo af al pi shehu aved: 
Kol hammocher pikkadon al pi bet din hare ze mocher laacherim veeno mocher leatzmo mippene hachashad vehaddamim yihyu munnachim etzlo veyesh lo lehishtammesh bahen. lefichach hare hu alehen shomer socher af al pi sheadayin lo nishtammesh bahen: 
Hammafkid maot etzel chenvani o hashshulchani im hayu tzerurin vachatumin o keshurin kesher meshunne hare ze lo yishtammesh bahen lefichach im avdu o nignevu eno chayyav beacharayutan. veim enan chatumin velo keshurin kesher meshunne af al pi shehen tzerurin yesh lo lehishtammesh bahen lefichach hu naase alehem shomer sachar veim avdu o nignevu chayyav beacharayutan veim neensu kegon sheavdu belistim mezuyyan hare ze patur: 
Bamme devarim amurim kodem sheyyishtammesh bahen aval achar shennishtammesh bahen nitchayyev beacharayutan kechol milve shebbaolam ad sheyyachzirem labbealim: 
Hammafkid maot etzel baal habbayit ben tzerurin ben muttarin hare ze lo yishtammesh bahen lefichach im avdu o nignevu eno chayyav beacharayutan. vehu sheyyitmenem bakkarka kemo shebbearnu: 
Hammafkid chavit etzel chavero ben sheyyichadu lah habbealim makom ben lo yichadu lah makom vetiltelah letzarko venishbera ben mittoch yado nishbera ben achar shehechzirah lammakom sheyyichadu lah nishbera chayyav leshallem. tiltelah letzarkah ben shennishbera mittoch yado ben shennishbera mishshehenichah bemakom acher patur: 
En mekabbelin pikdonot lo min hannashim velo min haavadim velo min hattinokot. kibbel min haishsha yachzir laishsha. meta yachzir levaalah. kibbel min haeved yachzir laeved. met yachzir lerabbo. kibbel min hakkatan yikne lo bo sefer tora o dekel sheyyochal bahen perotav. vechullan sheamru bishat mitatan shel peloni hem im neemanin lo yaase keferushan veim lav yachzir leyorshehem: 
Happikkadon vehaaveda lo nittenu littava ella bimkomam. ketzad. hifkid etzlo birushalayim eno yachol letavo benov veim hechzir lo benov mekabbelo mimmennu. hifkid etzlo bayyishshuv vehevi pikdono bammidbar eno mekabbelo mimmennu ella yomar lo hare hu beachrayutecha ad shettachazirennu li bayyishshuv kederech shehifkadti etzlecha bayyishshuv: 
Hammafkid etzel chavero vehalach baal happikkadon limdinat hayyam vahare hashshomer ratza lefaresh miyyabbasha layyam o latzet beshayyara yesh mi shehora sheim ba hashshomer vehevi happikkadon levet din niftar meacharayut shemirato udevarim shel taam hem sheen osrin ze bimdina zo mippene pikkadon shel ze shehalach vei efshar lo leholicho immo shemma yeera lo ones veyihye chayyav beacharayuto uvet din mafkidin oto beyad neeman etzlam mishshum heshshev aveda labbealim:
Mishneh Torah, Borrowing and Deposit 8:
Hammafkid etzel chavero behema o kelim venignevu o avdu amar hareni meshallem veeni nishba venimtza haggannav meshallem tashlume kefel. tavach o machar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. lemi meshallem lemi shehaya happikkadon etzlo shehare amar ashallem. chazra habbehema atzmah chozeret livaleha hi vegizzoteha uvaldoteha sheen ze hashshomer kone shevach habba miggufah ella shevach habba meelav. uchevar bearnu sheen haggannav machzir gizzot uveladot ella lifne yeush. nishba hashshomer velo ratza leshallem veachar kach nimtza haggannav meshallem tashlume kefel. tavach o machar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. lemi meshallem levaal happikkadon. vechen hassocher para mechavero venigneva veamar hareni meshallem veeni nishba veachar kach hukkar haggannav meshallem tashlume kefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha lassocher. sheillu ratza hassocher haya nishba shennigneva beones veniftar: 
Shomer chinnam sheamar pashati zacha bakkefel shehare chiyyev atzmo leshallem veillu ratza amar nigneva o avda vehaya patur. vechen nose sachar vehassocher sheamar nigneva kana hakkefel shehare chiyyev atzmo leshallem veillu ratza amar meta vehaya niftar. aval hashshoel eno kone hakkefel ad sheyyeshallem meatzmo kadam veshillem meatzmo veachar kach hukkar haggannav meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha lashshoel: 
Kol hakone hakkefel kone hashshevach habba meelav. ketzad. hifkid arba sein etzel chavero vahare hen shavin sela venignevu o avdu veamar hareni meshallem sela veeni nishba veachar kach nimtzeu vahare hen shavin arbaa selaim hare hen shel shomer veeno meshallem ella sela. bamme devarim amurim beshello hitrichan labbealim baddin aval im hoda sheppasha vechiyyevuhu bet din litten velo natan birtzono ad shekkafuhu bet din al karcho venatlu mimmennu veachar kach hukkar haggannav o nimtza happikkadon yachzir labbealim kemot shehu umachzirin lashshomer haddamim shellakchu mimmenno. veim kelim o karka gavu bet din mimmennu beshuma machzir lashshomer kelav o sadehu: 
Tevauhu bealim lashshomer venishba veachar kach shillem vehukkar haggannav hoil veshillem birtzono zacha bakkefel af al pi shehitricho battechilla laddin ad shennishba. amar hashshomer battechilla eni meshallem vechazar veamar hareni meshallem zacha bakkefel: 
Amar hareni meshallem vechazar veamar eni meshallem. o sheamar hareni meshallem umet veamru habbanim en anu meshallemin. o shello hispik litboa et hashshomer ad shemmet vetava habbanim veshillemu bene hashshomer. o sheshshillemu habbanim labbanim. o sheshshillem hashshomer mechetza. shaal shete parot veshillem achat mehen. shaal mehashshuttafin veshillem leechad mehen. shuttafin sheshshaalu veshillem echad mehen. shaal min haishsha veshillem levaalah. ishsha sheshshaala veshillem balah. kol ellu safek vahare hakkefel muttal besafek veeno tachat yad echad mehen lefichach cholkin hakkefel o hashshevach ben baal happikkadon uven hashshomer. veim kadam echad mehen vetafas hakkol en motziin miyyado vaafillu bechutza laaretz: 
Nignav happikkadon beones veachar kach hukkar haggannav echad shomer chinnam veechad shomer sachar ose din im haggannav veeno nishba. kadam venishba veachar kach hukkar haggannav im shomer chinnam hu ratza omed bishvuato ratza ose din im haggannav veim shomer sachar hu ose immo din. nignav happikkadon beones vehecheziro haggannav levet hashshomer vahare hu behema umeta sham bifshia yesh baddavar safek im kalta shemirato veniftar o adayin lo kalta shemirato lefichach hashshomer patur milleshallem. veim tafsu habbealim en motziin miyyadam: seliku lehu hilchot sheela uppikadon
Mishneh Torah, Circumcision 1: Mila mitzvat ase shechayyavin aleha karet shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 17 14)</small> "vearel zachar asher lo yimmol et besar arlato venichreta hannefesh hahiv meammeha". umitzva al haav lamul et beno veal harav lamul et avadav <small>(Bereshit 17 12)</small> "yelid bayit umiknat kesef". avar haav o haadon velo mal otan bittel mitzvat ase veeno chayyav karet sheen hakkaret taluy ella bearel atzmo. uvet din metzuvvim lamul oto habben o haeved bizmanno velo yannichu arel beyisrael velo beavdehen:

En malin beno shel adam shello middato ella im ken avar venimna lemulo shebbet din malin oto beal karcho. nitallem mibbet din velo malu oto. kesheyyigdal hu chayyav lamul et atzmo. vechol yom veyom sheyyaavor alav mishsheyyigdal velo yamul et atzmo hare hu mevattel mitzvat ase. aval eno chayyav karet ad sheyyamut vehu arel bemezid:

Echad eved shennolad birshut yisrael veechad eved hannilkach min hakkutim chayyav harav lamul otan. ella sheyyelid bayit nimmol lishmona. umiknat kesef nimmol bayyom shennilkach afillu lekacho bayyom shennolad nimmol beyomo:

Yesh miknat kesef shennimmol lishmona veyesh yelid bayit shennimmol bayyom shennolad. ketzad. lakach shifcha velakach ubbarah immah veyalda hare ze nimmol lishmona. veaf al pi shellakach haubbar bifne atzmo vahare haubbar atzmo miknat kesef hoil vekana immo kodem shennolad nimmol lishmona:

Lakach shifcha leubbareha. o shellakach shifcha al menat shello lehatebilah leshem avdut. af al pi shennolad birshuto nimmol bayyom shennolad. shehare hannolad hazze keillu hu miknat kesef levaddo ucheillu hayyom kanahu. sheen immo bichlal shifchot yisrael kede sheyyihye habben yelid bayit. veim tavla immo achar sheyyalda hare ze nimmol lishmona:

Lakach eved gadol min haakkum velo ratza haeved lamul megalgelin immo kol shenem asar chodesh. yeter al ken asur lekayyemo keshehu arel. ella chozer umochro leakkum. veim hitna alav mittechilla vehu etzel rabbo haakkum shello yamul oto muttar lekayyemo vehu arel. uvilvad sheyyekabbel alav sheva mitzvot shennitztauu bene noach veyihye keger toshav. aval im lo kibbel alav sheva mitzvot yehareg miyyad. veen mekabbelim ger toshav ella bizman shehayyovel noheg:

Ger shennichnas likhal yisrael chayyav mila techilla. veim mal keshehaya akkum tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit bayyom shennitgayyer. vechen katan shennolad keshehu mahul tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit bayyom hashshemini. anderoginus vehu hayyalud sheyyesh lo zachrut kezachar venakvut kinkeva tzarich lamul oto bashshemini. vechen yotze dofen umi sheyyesh lo shete arlot malin et shetehen bashshemini:

En malin leolam ella bayyom achar alot hashshemesh. ben bayyom hashshemini shehu zemannah ben shello bizmannah shehu mitteshii vahala shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 12 3)</small> "bayyom hashshemini" bayyom velo ballayla. mal mishsheala ammud hashshachar kasher. vechol hayyom kasher lemila. veaf al pi chen mitzva lehakedim bitchillat hayyom shezzerizin makdimin lemitzvot:

Mila bizmannah docha et hashshabbat. veshello bizmannah enah docha lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov. uven bizmannah uven shello bizmannah docha et hatztzaraat. ketzad. sheim hayta baheret beor haarla chotchah im haarla. af al pi shekketzitzat nega hatztzaraat belo taase yavo ase veyidche et lo taase:

Keshem shemmilat habbanim docha et hashshabbat kach milat haavadim shehen nimmolim lishmona docha et hashshabbat im chal shemini shellahen beshabbat. chutz milid bayit shello tavla immo ad sheyyalda sheaf al pi shennimmol lishmona eno doche et hashshabbat:

Katan shennolad keshehu mahul. umi shennolad bachodesh hashshemini leibburo kodem shettiggamer beriyyato shehu kenefel mippene sheeno chay. veyotze dofen veanderoginus umi sheyyesh lo shete arlot en dochin et hashshabbat ella nimolin beechad beshabbat shehu yom teshii shellahen:

Mi shennolad ben hashshemashot safek bayyom safek ballayla monin min hallayla venimmol litshii shehu safek shemini. veim nolad erev shabbat ben hashshemashot eno doche et hashshabbat ella nimmol beechad beshabbat. sheen dochin et hashshabbat missafek:

Mi shennolad bachodesh hashshemini. im haya shalem bisaro uvetzipparnav hare ze valad shalem uven shiva hu ella shennishtaha. umuttar letaltelo beshabbat veeno keeven. umalin oto beshabbat. aval im nolad usearo lakuy veen tzipparnav shelemin kivriyyatan hare ze ben shemona vadday shello haya rauy lehivvaled ella betisha veyatza kodem sheyyiggamer. ulefichach hu chashuv keeven veasur letaltelo beshabbat. veaf al pi chen im shaha sheloshim yom hare hu valad shel kayyama. vahare hu kishar hannoladin lechol davar. shekkol sheshshaha sheloshim yom baadam eno nefel:

Mi shennolad bachodesh hashshevii leibburo im nolad shalem hare ze valad shel kayyama umalin oto beshabbat. safek ben shiva safek ben shemona malin oto beshabbat al kol panim. im ben shiva hu veshalem hu bedin hu sheyyidche shabbat. veim ben shemona hu hare ze shemmal kimchattech basar hu lefi shezze nefel im hu ben shemona:

Hotzi haubbar rosho chutz lime immo ben hashshemashot af al pi shello yatza kullo ella belele shabbat en malin oto beshabbat. vechol mi sheeno doche et hashshabbat eno doche et yom tov rishon vedoche et yom tov sheni. uvishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana eno doche lo et harishon velo et hashsheni. vechen mila shello bizmannah enah docha et shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana:

Chole en malin oto ad sheyyavri. umonin lo meet sheyyavri mechalyo shiva yamim meet leet veachar kach malin oto. bamme devarim amurim beshechalatzto chamma vechayyotze becholi ze. aval im kaavu lo enav beet sheyyippatchu enav veyerafu malin oto miyyad. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Katan shennimtza bashshemini shello yarok beyoter en malin oto ad sheyyippol bo dam veyachzeru marav kemare hakketannim habberiim. vechen im haya adom beyoter kemi shetztzavu oto en malin oto ad sheyyibbala bo damo veyachzeru marav kishar hakketannim mippene shezze choli hu. vetzarich lehizzaher bidvarim ellu harebe:

Ishsha shemmala benah rishon umet mechamat mila shehichshila et kocho. vechen mala et hashsheni umet mechamat mila. ben mibbaalah harishon ben mibbaalah hashsheni hare ze lo yamul et hashshelishi bizmanno. ella mamtinin lo ad sheyyagdil veyitchazzek kocho. en malin ella valad sheen bo shum choli. shessakkanat nefashot docha et hakkol. veefshar lamul leachar zeman vei efshar lehachazir nefesh achat miyyisrael leolam:
Mishneh Torah, Circumcision 2: Hakkol kesherin lamul. vaafillu arel veeved veishsha vekatan malin bemakom sheen sham ish. aval akkum lo yamul kelal. veim mal eno tzarich lachazor velamul sheniyya. uvakkol malin vaafillu betzur uvizchuchit uvechol davar shekkoret. velo yamul bikrumit shel kane mippene hassakkana. umitzva min hammuvchar lamul bevarzel ben besakkin ben bemisparayim. venahagu kol yisrael besakkin:

Ketzad mohalin. chotchin et kol haor hamechappe et haatara ad shettitgalle kol haatara. veachar kach porin et hakkerum harach shellematta min haor betzipporen umachaziro lechan ulechan ad sheyyerae besar haatara. veachar kach motzetz et hammila ad sheyyetze haddam mimmekomot rechokim kede shello yavo lide sakkana. vechol mi sheeno motzetz maavirin oto. veachar shemmotzetz noten aleha ispelanit o retiyya vechayyotze bahen:

Yesh tzitzin meakkevin et hammila veyesh tzitzin sheen meakkevin et hammila. ketzad. im nishar meor haarla or hachofe rov gavhah shel atara hare ze arel kemot shehaya. veze haor hu tzitz hameakkev. veim lo nishar mimmennu ella meat sheeno chofe rov gavhah shel atara zehu tzitz sheeno meakkev:

Hammal kol zeman sheosek bammila chozer ben al hatztzitzin shemmeakkevin ben al tzitzin sheen meakkevin. perash, al tzitzin hameakkevin chozer, al tzitzin sheenan meakkevin eno chozer. mal velo para et hammila keillu lo mal:

Katan shebbesaro rach umeduldal beyoter o shehaya baal basar ad sheyyerae keillu eno mahul roin oto beet sheyyitkashshe. im nire shehu mahul eno tzarich kelum. vetzarich letakken et habbasar mikkan umikkan mippene marit haayin. veim beet sheyyitkashshe lo nire mahul chozrin vekotztzin et habbasar hameduldal mikkan umikkan ad shetterae haatara geluya beet kishshuy. vedavar ze middivre sofrim. aval min hattora af al pi shehu nire kearel hoil umal eno tzarich lamul paam sheniyya:

Osin kol tzarche mila beshabbat. malin uforin umotztzin. vechozer al tzitzin hameakkevin af al pi shepperash veal tzitzin sheen meakkevin kol zeman shello perash. venoten aleha ispelanit. aval machshire mila enan dochin et hashshabbat. ketzad. hare shello matzu sakkin en osin sakkin beshabbat velo meviin oto mimmakom lemakom. vaafillu mavoy sheeno meorav en meviin oto mechatzer lechatzer. veen eruv middivrehem nidche mippene havaat hassakkin hoil veefshar lahavio meerev shabbat:

Vechen en shochakin lah sammanin veen mechimmin lah chammin. veen osin lah ispelanit. veen torfin yayin veshemen. veim lo shachak kammon meerev shabbat loes beshinnav venoten. veim lo taraf yayin veshemen noten ze leatzmo veze leatzmo. ze hakkelal, kol sheefshar laasoto meerev shabbat eno doche et hashshabbat. aval im shachach velo hechinu hammachshirin tiddache hammila litshii:

Malu et hakkatan beshabbat veachar kach nishpechu hachammin o nitpazzeru hassammanin osin lo hakkol beshabbat mippene shessakkana hi lo. makom sheddarkan leharechitz et hakkatan marchitzin oto beshabbat beyom hammila ben lifne hammila ben leachar hammila, o bashshelishi shel mila shechal lihyot beshabbat. ben rechitzat kol gufo. ben rechitzat mila. ben bechammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat ben bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat. mippene shessakkana hi lo:

Shachchu velo heviu sakkin meerev shabbat omer leakkum lehavi sakkin beshabbat. uvilvad shello yavi oto derech reshut harabbim. kelalo shel davar kol davar sheasiyyato beshabbat asura alenu mishshum shevut muttar lanu lomar leakkum laasot otan kede laasot mitzva bizmannah. vedavar sheasiyyato asura alenu mishshum melacha asur lanu lomar leakkum laasoto beshabbat:

Machshire mila afillu bizmannah enan dochin et yom tov hoil veefshar laasotan meerev yom tov. vekal vachomer haddevarim, im lo dachu machshire mila shevut shehu middivrehem heach yidchu lo taase shebbattora. aval shochakin lah sammanin beyom tov hoil verauy likdera. vetorfin lah yayin veshemen:
Mishneh Torah, Circumcision 3: Hammal mevarech kodem sheyyamul asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammila, im mal ben chavero. veim mal et beno mevarech vetzivvanu lamul et habben. vaavi habben mevarech beracha acheret. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehacheniso bivrito shel avraham avinu. mitzva al haav lamul et beno yater al mitzva shemmetzuvvin yisrael sheyyamulu kol arel shebbenehen. lefichach im en sham aviv en mevarchin achareha beracha zo. veyesh mi shehora sheyyevarchu otah bet din o echad min haam. veen rauy laasot ken:
Veim hayu sham omdin omrim keshem shehichnasto labberit ken tachnisehu letora ulechuppa ulemaasim tovim:

Veachar kach mevarech avi habben o hammal o echad min haomdin sham. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddash yedid mibbeten vechok bishero sam vetzeetzaav chatam beot berit kodesh al ken bischar zot el chay chelkenu tzurenu tzavve lehatztzil yedidut sheerenu mishshachat lemaan berito asher sam bivsarenu. baruch atta Adonai koret habberit. vaavi habben mevarech shehecheyanu:

Hammal et haggerim mevarech. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lamul et haggerim ulehattif mimmennu dam berit sheilmale dam habberit lo nitkayyemu shamayim vaaretz shenneemar <small>(yirmeya log ko)</small> "im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti":

Hammal et avdo mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lamul et haavadim ulehattif mehen dam berit sheilmale dam berit lo nitkayyemu shamayim vaaretz. veim mal eved shel acherim mevarech al milat haavadim. vehammal adam gadol tzarich lechassot ervato ad sheyyevarech veachar kach megallehu umal oto:
Ger shemmal kodem shennitgayyer vekatan shennolad keshehu mahul keshemmattifin mimmennu dam berit enan tzerichin beracha. vechen anderoginus en mevarchin al millato mippene shehu eno zachar vadday:

Akkum shetztzarich lachtoch arlato mippene makka o mippene shechin shennolad bo haya asur leyisrael lachtoch lo otah, shehaakkum en maalim otam mide mita velo moridin otan eleha, af al pi shennaaset mitzva birfua zo, shehare lo nitkavven lemitzva. lefichach im nitkavven haakkum lemila muttar leyisrael lamul oto:

Meusa hi haarla shennitgannu bah haggoyim shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 9 25)</small> "ki kol haggoyim arelim". ugedola hi hammila shello nikra avraham avinu shalem ad shemmal shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 17 1)</small> "hithallech lefanay vehye tamim" <small>(Bereshit 17 2)</small> "veettena veriti beni uvenecha" vegomer. vechol hammefer berito shel avraham avinu vehinniach arlato o meshachah af al pi sheyyesh bo tora umaasim tovim en lo chelek laolam habba:

Bo uree kamma chamura mila shello nitla lemoshe rabbenu aleha afillu shaa achat af al pi shehaya badderech. vechol mitzvot hattora nichretu alehen shalosh beritot. shenneemar (Devarim 28 69) "elle divre habberit asher tzivva Adonai", (Devarim 28 69) "millevad habberit asher karat ittam bechorev". vesham hu omer (Devarim 29 9) "attem nitztzavim hayyom kullechem" (Devarim 29 11) "leavrecha bivrit Adonai elohecha", hare shalosh beritot. veal hammila nichretu shelosh esre beritot im avraham avinu. (Bereshit 17 2) "veettena veriti beni uvenecha". (Bereshit 17 4) "ani hinne veriti ittach". vahakimoti et beriti beni uvenecha. livrit olam. (Bereshit 17 9) "veatta et beriti tishmor". (Bereshit 17 10) "zot beriti asher tishmeru". (Bereshit 17 11) "vehaya leot berit". (Bereshit 17 13) "vehayta veriti bivsarchem". livrit olam. (Bereshit 17 14) "et beriti hefar". (Bereshit 17 19) "vahakimoti et beriti itto. livrit olam". (Bereshit 17 21) "veet beriti akim et yitzchak":
berich rachamana desayyean
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 1:
Mitzvat ase lehalevot laaniyye yisrael shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 24)</small> "im kesef talve et ammi et heani immach". yachol reshut talmud lomar <small>(Devarim 15 8)</small> "haavet taavitennu" vegomer. umitzva zo gedola min hatztzedaka el heani hashshoel shezze kevar nitzrach lishl veze adayin lo higgia lemidda zo. vehattora hikpida al mi sheyyimmana millehalvot leani shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 9)</small> "veraa encha beachicha haevyon" vegomer: 
Kol hannoges heani vehu yodea sheen lo ma yachazir lo over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 24)</small> "lo tihye lo kenshe". umitzvat ase lingosho et haakkum ulehatzer lo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 3)</small> "lannachri tiggsho" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo mitzvat ase: 
Asur laadam lehareot atzmo levaal chovo bizman sheyyodea sheen lo. afillu laavor lefanav shello yafchido o yachlimo af al pi sheeno tovo veen tzarich lomar im tevao. ucheshem sheasur leze litboa kach asur lallo lichbosh mamon chavero shebbeyado velomar lo lech veshuv vehu sheyyesh lo shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 28)</small> "al tomar lereacha lech veshuv". vechen asur lallo likkach halevaa ulehotziah shello letzorech uleabbedah ad shello yimtza baal chov meayin yigbe af al pi shehammalve ashir gadol. veose ze rasha hu shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 37 21)</small> "lo rasha velo yeshallem". vetziuu chachamim <small>(mishna avot 2 12)</small> "yehi mamon chavercha chaviv alecha keshellach": 
Kesheyyitba hammalve halevaato af al pi shehu ashir vehallo dachuk vetarud bimzonot en merachamin baddin ella govin lo chovo ad peruta acharona mikkol mittaltelin sheyyimmatzu lo. veim lo hispiku hammittaltelin govin lo min hakkarka achar shemmachrimin al mi sheyyesh lo mittaltelin o mi sheyyada lo mittaltelin velo yeviem levet din. vegovin mikkol karka sheyyesh lo af al pi shehi meshubedet lichtubbat ishto o levaal chovo shekkadam govin laze veim yavo harishon veyitrof yitrof. taan hallo shemmittaltelin ellu shebbeyadi enan shelli ella pikkadon hem beyadi o sechurin o sheulin en shomin lo o yavi reaya o yigbe mehen baal chovo: 
En baal chov gove lo mikkesut ishto uvanav shel lo velo mibbegadim tzevuim shetztzevaan lishman af al pi sheadayin lo lavshu otan velo missandalim chadashim shellekachan lishman ella hare ellu shellahen. bamme devarim amurim bichle hachol aval bigde shabbat vehammoed gove otan baal chov veen tzarich lomar im hayu bahen tabbaot uchele zahav o kesef shehakkol levaal chovo: 
Hayu lo mittaltelin o karka vahare alav shetar chovot laakkum veamar hare kol nechasay meshubadin laakkum veim yittelu otan hayyisreelim bechovam yaasru oti haakkum bechovan veehye bashshivya. horu rabbotay sheen shomin lo veyigbu hayyisreelim. uchesheyyavou haakkum veyaasruhu hare kol yisrael metzuvvin lifdoto: 
Mesadderin levaal chov kederech shemmesadderin baarachin. ketzad. omer lallo have kol hammittaltelin sheyyesh lecha velo tanniach afillu machat achat. venotnin lo min hakkol mezon [sheloshim] yom uchesut shenem asar chodesh mikkesut haruya lo. velo sheyyilbash bigde meshi o mitznefet zehuva ella maavirin otah mimmenno. venotnin lo kesut haruya lo lishnem asar chodesh. umitta leshev aleha umitta umatztza haruyin lo lishon alehem. veim haya ani mitta umappatz lishon alav. veen notnin kelim kaellu leishto uvanav af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotehem. venotnin lo sandalav utefillav. haya umman notnin lo shene kele ummanut mikkol min umin kegon shehaya charash notnin lo shene maatzadin ushete megerot. haya lo min echad merubbe umin echad muat notnin lo shenayim min hamerubbe vechol sheyyesh lo min hammuat. veen lokchin lo kelim middeme hamerubbe. haya ikkar o chammar en notnin lo lo tzimdo velo chamoro. vechen im haya sappan en notnin lo sefinato af al pi sheen lo mezonot ella meellu en ellu kelim ella nechasim veyimmachru im shear hammittaltelin bevet din veyinnatnu levaal chovo: 
Malve shebba lehippara shello bifne hallo kegon shehaya hallo bimdina rechoka vetafsa haishsha mittaltelin minnichse habbaal kede shettizzon mehen motziin otan miyyadah venotnin levaal chov sheafillu haya balah immah lo haya yachol lazun et ishto uvanav ad sheyyifra lo kol chovo:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 2:
Din tora shebbizman sheyyitba hammalve et chovo im nimtzeu lallo nechasim mesadderin lo venotnin levaal chovo et hashshear kemo shebbearnu. veim lo nimtza lallo kelum o nimtzeu lo devarim shemmesadderin lo bilvad yelech hallo ledarko veen osrin oto veen omrim lo have reaya sheatta ani velo mashbiin oto kederech sheddanin haakkum shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 24)</small> "lo tihye lo kenshe". ella omrim lammalve im atta yodea nechasim leze hamechuyyav lecha lech utefos otan: 
Taan sheyyesh lo vehechbi otan vahare hen betoch beto en min haddin sheyyikkanes leveto lo hu velo sheliach bet din shehattora hikpida al ze shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 11)</small> "bachutz taamod". aval machrimin al mi sheyyesh lo velo yitten levaal chovo. kesherau haggeonim harishonim sheamdu achar chibbur haggemara sherabbu harammaim veninala delet bifne loyn hitkinu shemmashbiin et hallo shevua chamura keen shel tora binkitat chefetz sheen lo kelum yeter al devarim shemmesadderin lo. veshello hechbian beyad acherim veshello natan mattana al menat lehachezir. vecholel bishvua zo shekkol sheyyarviach vechol sheyyavo leyado o lirshuto measher tassig yado lo yaachil mimmennu kelum lo leishto velo levanav velo yalbish otan velo yetappel bahen velo yitten mattana leadam baolam. ella yotzi mikkol asher tassig yado mezon sheloshim yom uchesut shenem asar chodesh mazon harauy lo uchesut harauy lo. lo achilat hazzollim vehassovin o bene melachim velo malbushe happachot vehasseganim ella kedarko. vechol hayyeter al tzarko yitten levaal chovo rishon rishon ad sheyyagbennu kol chovo. umachrimin techilla al mi sheyyeda lifloni nechasim geluyin o temunin velo yodia levet din. gam achar hattakkana hazzot en baal chov yachol lehikkanes letoch beto shel lo lo hu velo sheliach bet din shello tikkenu laakor guf hattora ella hallo atzmo yotzi kelav o yomar kach vechach hu sheyyesh li mannichin harauy lo veyotzi hashshear veyishshava betakkana zo vechaze danin yisrael bechol mekomotan. nire lo mamon achar shennishba shevua zo veamar shel acherim hu o esek hu beyadi en shomin lo ad sheyyavi reaya. vechen horu rabbotay: 
Mi shennishba shevua zo sheen lo kelum vechol ma sheyyarviach yitten levaal chov en kol echad mibbaale chovot ba umashbio sheshshevua achat kolelet kol baale chovot. vetakkanat acharonim hi veen medakdekin bah lehachemir ella lehakel: 
Mi shehuchzak shehu ani vechasher veholech betom vehaddavar galuy veyadua laddayyan ulerov haam uva baal chovo lehashebio betakkana zo vehuchzak hattovea sheeno mistappek baaniyyut ze ella rotze letzaaro bishvua zo lehatzer lo ulevayyesho barabbim kede lehinnakem mimmennu o kede sheyyelech veyilve min haakkum o yikkach nichse ishto veyitten laze ad sheyyinnatzel mishshevua zo. yerae li sheasur ledayyan yere shamayim lehashebio shevua zo veim hishbio bittel lo taase shel tora lo tihye lo kenoshe. velo od ella rauy laddayyan ligor battovea uletardo mippene shehu noter veholech bishrirut libbo. shello tikkenu haggeonim takkana zo ella mippene harammain vahare neemar <small>(Devarim 22 2)</small> "ad derosh achicha oto" darshehu im rammay hu o eno rammay umeachar shehuchzak ze shehu ani vesheeno rammay asur lehashebio. vechen ani omer shemmi shehuchzak rammay uderachav mekulkalin bemassao umattano vahare hu amud sheyyesh lo mamon vetaan sheen lo kelum vahare hu ratz lehishshava betakkana zo sheen rauy lehashebio ella im yesh koach baddayyan laasoto ad sheyyifra baal chovo o lenaddoto ad sheyyitten yaase meachar shehu amud. shepperiat baal chov mitzva. kelalo shel davar kol sheyyaase haddayyan middevarim ellu vechavvanato lirdof hatztzedek bilvad shennitztavvenu leradfo velo laavor haddin al echad mibbaale dinin hare ze murshe laasot umekabbel sachar. vehu sheyyihyu maasav leshem shamayim: 
Mi shennitchayyev bishvua zo mippene shetar chov shealav vehoda laacherim bechovot acherim vehissiga yado yeter al harauy lo lo yittol hayyeter ella baale shetarot bilvad. shemma kenuneya ose behodaato al nechasav shel ze: 
Reuven shehaya chayyav leshimon mea velevi chayyav liruven mea motziin millevi venotnin leshimon. lefichach im en liruven nechasim vehayu lo shitre chov al levi veamar levi shetar amana hu parua hu vehoda lo reuven en mashgichin al hodaato shemma kenuneya hem osin leabbed zechuto shel shimon ella yishshava shimon veyittol millevi kedin kol toref sheeno nifra ella bishvua. vechen kol mi sheyyesh alav shetar chov vehoda leacher meatzmo bechov acher im en lo nechasim kede sheyyigbu shenehem gove baal hashshetar bilvad shello yaasu kenuneya al shetaro shel ze: 
Asur laadam lehalevot meotav belo edim vaafillu letalmid chacham ella im ken hilvahu al hammashkon. vehammalve bishtar meshubbach yater. vechol hammalve belo edim over mishshum <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl" vegorem kelala leatzmo: 
Harav shellava meavdo veachar kach shichrero o lava meishto veachar kach gershah en lahen alav kelum shekkol ma shekkana eved kana rabbo vechol hammaot shebbeyad haishsha bechezkat balah ella im hevia reaya shehen minnedunyatah:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 3:
Almana ben shehi aniyya ben shehi ashira en memashkenin otah lo bishat halevaa velo shello bishat halevaa velo al pi bet din shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 17)</small> "velo tachavol beged almana". veim chaval machazirin mimmennu beal karcho. veim tode lo teshallem veim tichpor tishshava. avad hammashkon o nisraf kodem sheyyachzir loke: 
Vechen hammalve et chavero ben shehilvahu al hammashkon ben shemmishkeno achar halevaa beyado o al pi bet din lo yachavol kelim sheosin bahem ochel nefesh kegon harechayim vehaarevot shel etz veyorot shemmevashshelin bahem vesakkin shel shechita vechayyotze bahen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 6)</small> "ki nefesh hu chovel". veim chaval machzir beal karcho veim avad hammashkon o nisraf kodem sheyyachzir loke: 
Chaval kelim harebe shel ochel nefesh kegon shechaval areva veyora vesakkin chayyav al kol keli ucheli bifne atzmo. afillu shene kelim shehen osin melacha achat chayyav alehen mishshum shene kelim veloke shetayim al shenehem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 6)</small> "lo yachavol rechayim" varachev lechayyev al harechayim bifne atzmo veal harechev bifne atzmo. keshem sheharechev veharechayim meyuchadin shehen shene kelim umeshammeshin melacha achat vechayyav al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo kach kol shene kelim af al pi shemmeshammeshin melacha achat chayyav al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo. vechen im chaval tzemed bakar hachoresh loke shetayim: 
Hammalve et chavero [echad] ani veechad ashir lo yemashkenennu ella bevet din vaafillu sheliach bet din shebba lemashken lo yikkanes leveto vimashkenennu ella omed bachutz vehallo nichnas leveto umotzi lo hammashkon shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 11)</small> "bachutz taamod". im ken ma ben baal chov lishliach bet din. sheshsheliach bet din yesh lo likkach hammashkon miyyad hallo bizroa venotno lammalve uvaal chov en lo likkach hammashkon ad sheyyitten lo hallo middato. avar baal chov venichnas levet hallo umishkeno o shechataf hammashkon miyyado bizroa eno loke shehare nittak laase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 13)</small> "hashev tashiv lo et haavot kevo hashshemesh". veim lo kiyyem ase shebbah kegon sheavad hammashkon o nisraf loke. umechashshev deme hammashkon vetovea hashshear bedin: 
Echad hamemashken et chavero bevet din o shemmishkeno beyado bizroa o middaat hallo im ish ani hu umishkeno davar shehu tzarich lo hare ze metzuvve lehachezir lo haavot beet shehu tzarich lo. machzir lo et hakkar ballayla kede lishon alav veet hammachresha bayyom kede laasot bah melachto shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 13)</small> "hashev tashiv lo et haavot". avar velo heshiv lo keli hayyom bayyom ucheli hallayla ballayla over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 12)</small> "lo tishkav baavoto" lo tishkav vaavoto etzlecha zo kesut layla. uvechelim shehu ose bahen melachto bayyom o lovshan hu omer <small>(Shemot 22 25)</small> "ad bo hashshemesh teshivennu lo" melammed sheyyachaziro kol hayyom. im ken hu shemmachzir lo hammashkon beet shehu tzarich lo velokeach otah beet sheeno tzarich lo ma yoil hammashkon. kede shello yishshamet hachov bishviit velo yease mittaltelin etzel banav ella yippara min hammashkon achar shemmet hallo. ha lamadta shehamemashken et heani davar shehu tzarich lo velo hecheziro lo bizmanno over mishshum shelosha shemot mishshum <small>(Devarim 24 10)</small> "lo tavo el beto" umishshum hashev tashiv lo et haavot umishshum lo tishkav baavoto. bamme devarim amurim shemmishkeno shello bishat halevaato. aval im mishkeno bishat halevaato eno chayyav lehachezir kelal veeno over beshem min hashshemot haellu: 
Sheliach bet din shebba lemashken lo yemashken devarim shei efshar laadam litten otam mashkon kegon beged shealav ucheli sheochel bo vechayyotze beellu. umanniach mitta umatztza leashir umitta umappatz leani. vechol hannimtza beyado chutz meellu yesh lo lemashkeno veyachzir lo keli hayyom bayyom ucheli hallayla ballayla. hayu lefanav shene kelim notel echad umachazir echad. ad matay hu chayyav lehachezir velikkach ad leolam. veim haya hammashkon middevarim sheeno tzarich lahem veen mannichin otan lallo hare ze mannicho etzlo ad sheloshim yom umishsheloshim yom veelach mocher hammashkon bevet din. met hallo eno machzir levanav. met hallo achar sheheshiv lo hammashkon shomto hammalve meal banav veeno machzir: 
Hearev muttar lemashken bizroa ulehikkanes leveto velittol hammashkon shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 20 16)</small> "lekach bigdo ki arav zar". vechen mi sheyyesh lo sachar etzel chavero ben sechar melachto ben sechar behemto vechelav ben sechar beto hare ze muttar lemashkeno shello al pi bet din venichnas leveto venotel hammashkon bischaro. veim zakaf alav hassachar bemilve asur shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 10)</small> "ki tashshe vereacha mashshat meuma" vegomer: 
Mi shehaya beyado mashkono shel ani im haya secharo yater al pechato kegon kardom umassar [haggadol] vechayyotze bahen hare ze muttar lehasekiro umenakke secharo tamid bechovo mippene shezze kemeshiv aveda veen tzarich reshut bealim:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 4:
Neshech umarbit echad hu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 37)</small> "et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech uvemarbit lo titten achlecha" ulehallan hu omer <small>(Devarim 23 20)</small> "neshech kesef neshech ochel neshech kol davar asher yishshach". velamma nikra shemo neshech mippene shehu noshech shemmetzaer et chavero veochel et besaro. velamma chillekan hakkatuv laavor alav bishne lavin: 
Kederech sheasur lehalevot kach asur lilvot beribbit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 20)</small> "lo tashshich leachicha" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara lallo kelomar lo tinshoch leachich. vechen asur lehitassek ben lo umalve beribbit. vechol mi shehaya arev o sofer o ed benehen hare ze over belo taase. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 24)</small> "lo tesimun alav neshech" zo azhara af laedim velaarev velassofer. ha lamadta shehammalve beribbit over al shishsha lavin. <small>(Shemot 22 24)</small> "lo tihye lo kenshe". <small>(Vayikra 25 37)</small> "et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech". <small>(Vayikra 25 37)</small> "uvemarbit lo titten achlecha". <small>(Vayikra 25 36)</small> "al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit". lo tesimun alav neshech. <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl". vehallo over bishnayim. lo tashshich leachicha. velifne ivver lo titten michshol. arev veedim vechayyotze bahen en ovrin ella mishshum lo tesimun alav neshech. vechol mi shehaya sarsur ben shenehem o shessiyyea echad mehen o horahu over mishshum lifne ivver lo titten michshol: 
Af al pi shehammalve vehallo ovrin al kol ellu hallavin enan lokin alav mippene shennittan lehishshavon. shekkol hammalve beribbit im hayta ribbit ketzutza shehi asura min hattora hare zo yotza bedayyanin umotziin otah min hammalve umachzirin lallo. veim met hammalve en motziin miyyad habbanim: 
Hinniach lahem avihem maot shel ribbit af al pi shehen yodin shehen shel ribbit enan chayyavim lehachezir. hinniach lahem para vetallit shel ribbit vechol davar hamesuyyam chayyavim lehachezir mippene kevod avihen. bamme devarim amurim kesheasa teshuva velo hispik lehachezir ad shemmet. aval im lo asa teshuva en choshshin lichvodo vaafillu davar hamesuyyam en machazirin: 
Haggazlanin umalve beribbit shehechziru en mekabbelin mehen kede liftoach lahen derech litshuva. vechol hamekabbel mehen en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu. im hayta gezela kayyemet veharibbit davar hamesuyyam vahare hu beatzmo mekabbelin mehen: 
Shetar shekkatuv bo ribbit ben ketzutza ben shel divrehem gove et hakkeren veeno gove et haribbit. kadam vegava hakkol motziin mimmennu haribbit ketzutza. aval avak ribbit shehu middivrehem eno gove min hallo lammalve veen machazirin oto min hammalve lallo: 
Kol hakkotev shetar ribbit hare ze kechotev umeid alav edim shekkafar baAdonai elohe yisrael. vechen kol hallo umalve beribbit benan leven atzman hare hen kechofrim baAdonai elohe yisrael vechafru bitziat mitzrayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 37)</small> "et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 25 38)</small> "ani Adonai elohechem asher hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim": 
Asur leadam lehalevot banav uvene beto beribbit. af al pi sheeno makpid umattana hu shennoten lahen hare ze asur shemma yargilem bedavar ze: 
Talmide chachamim shehilvu ze et ze venatan lo yeter al ma shehilva mimmennu hare ze muttar shehaddavar yadua shello natan lo ella mattana shehare hen yodin chomer issur haribbit: 
Hammalve et chavero umatza hallo yoter [o shehechzir lo chovo umatza hammalve yoter] im bichde shehaddaat toa chayyav lehachezir veim lav mattana hu shennatan lo o gezela hayta lo beyado vehivlia lo becheshbon o acher tzivva lehavelia lo. bechamma haddaat toa beechad uvishnayim o bachamishsha o baasara shemma mana chamishsha chamishsha o asara asara. vechen im matza yater minyan hachamishiyyot o minyan haasiriyyot echad echad chayyav lehachezir lo shemma haachadim shehaya mone bahen hachamishiyyot o haasiriyyot nitarvu immahem: 
Hammalve et chavero al hammatbea vechen hakkotev leishto bichtubbatah matbea yadua uferesh mishkalo vehosifu al mishkalo im huzelu happerot mechamat hattosefet menakke lo shiur hattosefet vaafillu hosifu alav kol shehu. veim lo huzelu mechamat hattosefet eno menakke lo ella noten lo mimmatbea hayyotze beotah shaa. bamme devarim amurim beshehosifu alav ad chamishito kegon shehaya mishkalo arbaa vaasao chamishsha aval im hosifu lo yoter al chamishito menakke lo kol hattosefet af al pi shello huzelu happerot. vehu haddin lemalve al hammatbea ufachatu mimmennu: 
Hammalve et chavero al hammatbea venifsal im yachol lehotzio bimdina acheret veyesh lo derech leotah medina noten lo mimmatbea shehilvahu veomer lo lech vehotzio bemakom peloni. veim en lo derech lesham noten lo mimmatbea hayyotze beotah shaa. vechen bichtubba: 
Horu miktzat haggeonim shehallo shemmachal lammalve beribbit shellakach mimmennu o sheatid likkach af al pi shekkanu miyyado shemmachal o natan mattana eno moil kelum shekkol ribbit shebbaolam mechila hi aval hattora lo machala veasra mechila zo ulefichach en hammechila moelet beribbit afillu beribbit shel divrehem. yerae li sheen horaa zo nechona ella meachar sheomrim lammalve lehachezir lo veyada hammalve sheddevar issur asa veyesh lo littol mimmennu im ratza limchol mochel kederech shemmochel haggezel. uveferush amru chachamim shehaggazlanin umalve beribbit shehechziru en mekabbelin mehen mikkelal shehammechila moelet: 
Nichse yetomim muttar litten otam leadam neeman sheyyesh lo nechasim tovim karov lesachar verachok lehefsed. ketzad. omer lo tihye nose venoten bahen im yesh sham revach ten lahem chelkan min harevach veim yesh sham hefsed tafsid atta levaddecha shezze avak ribbit hu vechol avak ribbit enah asura ella middivrehem uvenichse yetomim lo gazru:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 5:
Haakkum veger toshav loyn mehen umalvin otan beribbit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 20)</small> "lo tashshich leachicha" leachich asur velishar haolam muttar. umitzvat ase lehashshich leakkum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 21)</small> "lannachri tashshich" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo mitzvat ase vezehu din tora: 
Asru chachamim sheyyihye yisrael malve et haakkum beribbit ketzutza ella bichde chayyav. gazru shemma yilmod mimmaasav berov yeshivato immo. lefichach muttar lilvot min haakkum beribbit shehare hu boreach millefanav veeno ragil etzlo. vetalmid chacham sheeno ragil bo lilmod mimmaasav muttar lehalevot laakkum beribbit afillu lehareviach. vechol avak ribbit im haakkum mutteret lakkol: 
Yisrael shellava maot min haakkum beribbit uvikkesh lehacheziram lo. metzao yisrael acher veamar lo tenem li vaani maale lecha kederech sheatta maale laakkum. hare zo ribbit ketzutza afillu heemido etzel haakkum ad sheyyittol haakkum meotav veyachzor veyittenem beyad yisrael haacher: 
Akkum shellava maot miyyisrael beribbit uvikkesh lehacheziram lo. metzao yisrael acher veamar lo tenem li vaani maale lecha kederech sheatta maale leyisrael hare ze muttar. veim heemido etzel yisrael af al pi shennatan haakkum hammaot beyado hoil umiddaat yisrael natan hare zo ribbit ketzutza: 
Asur leyisrael litlot meotav beyad akkum kede lehalevotan beribbit leyisrael. veakkum shehilva et yisrael beribbit asur leyisrael acher lihyot lo arev shekkevan shebbedinehem shettovea hearev techilla nimtza hearev tovea et yisrael beribbit shehearev chayyav bah laakkum. lefichach im kibbel alav haakkum shello yitba et hearev techilla hare ze muttar: 
Yisrael shellava maot min haakkum beribbit uzekafan alav bemilve venitgayyer im ad shello nitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve gove et hakkeren veharibbit veim mishshennitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve gove et hakkeren velo et haribbit. aval akkum shellava miyyisrael beribbit vezakaf alav et haribbit bemilve af al pi shezzekafan alav acher shennitgayyer gove et hakkeren veet haribbit shello yomru bishvil meotav nitgayyer ze. vegove hayyisrael mimmennu achar shennitgayyer kol meot haribbit shennitchayyev bahen keshehaya akkum: 
Mitzva lehakedim halevaat yisrael bechinnam lehalevaat akkum beribbit: 
Asur leadam sheyyitten meotav karov lesachar verachok lehefsed shezze avak ribbit hu vehaose chen nikra rasha. veim natan cholkin bassachar uvahefsed kedin haesek. vehannoten meotav karov lehefsed verachok lesachar hare ze nikra chasid: 
En moshivin chenvani lemachatzit sachar velo yitten maot likkach bahen perot lemachatzit sachar velo betzim lehoshiv tachat hattarnegolin shello lemachatzit sachar veen shamin agalim useyachin lefatteman lemachatzit sachar ella im ken natan lo sechar amalo umezono. o yihye revach hammitassek yoter al hefsedo kemo shebbearnu beinyan hashshuttafut: 
Hammishtattef im chavero bemaot o bekarka o hannoten lo esek lo yetzaref hassachar im hakkeren shemma lo yihye sham sachar venimtzeu bain lide ribbit. vechen lo yitten lo maot betorat esek o shuttafut veyichtov otan milve shemma yamut venimtza hashshetar beyad hayyoresh vegove bo et haribbit: 
Asur lehakedim haribbit o leacher oto. ketzad. natan enav lilvot mimmennu vehaya meshalleach lo sivlonot bishvil sheyyalvehu zo hi ribbit mukdemet. lava mimmennu vehechzir lo meotav vehaya meshalleach lo sivlonot bishvil meotav shehayu betelin etzlo zo hi ribbit meucheret. veim avar veose chen hare ze avak ribbit: 
Mi shellava mechavero velo haya ragil mikkodem lehakedim lo shalom asur lehakedim lo shalom. veen tzarich lomar sheyyekalleso bidvarim o yashkim lefitcho shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 20)</small> "neshech kol davar" afillu devarim asurim. vechen asur lo lelammed et hammalve mikra o gemara kol zeman shemmeotav beyado im lo haya ragil baze mikkodem shenneemar neshech kol davar: 
Hammalve et chavero lo yomar lo da im ba ish peloni mimmakom peloni (kelomar) shettechabbedo vetaachilo vetashkehu karauy. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Yesh devarim shehen kemo ribbit umuttarin ketzad. lokeach adam shitrotav shel chavero befachot veeno choshesh. umuttar leadam litten lachavero dinar kede sheyyalve lifloni mea dinarin shello asra tora ella ribbit habbaa min hallo lammalve. vechen omer adam lachavero he lecha dinar ze veemor lifloni sheyyalveni. shello natan ella sechar amira: 
Yesh devarim shehen muttarin veasur laasotan mippene haaramat ribbit. ketzad. amar lo haleveni mane amar lo mane en li chittim yesh li bemane venatan lo chittim bemane vechazar ulekachan mimmennu betishim hare ze muttar. aval asaruhu mippene haaramat ribbit shehare natan lo tishim velokeach mane. veim avar veasa kaze hare hu motzi mimmennu mea bedin sheafillu avak ribbit en kan. vechen mi shehayta sade memushkenet beyado lo yachzor veyaskir otah levaal hassade mippene haaramat ribbit shehare ze omed besadehu keshehaya venoten laze sachar bechol chodesh bishvil meotav shehilvahu: 
Asur lehasekir haddinarin sheen ze dome lemaskir et hakkeli shehakkeli chozer beatzmo veze motzi ellu umevi dinarin acherot venimtza ze avak ribbit: 
Melech shehayu dinav shekkol mi sheyyitten hammas hakkatzuv al kol ish veish al yede ze shello natan yishtabed bo venatan al yado dinar af al pi shemmeshabed bo yeter middinar hare ze muttar. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 6:
Hammalve et chavero sela bachamishsha dinarim o satayim chittim beshalosh o sela besela usea o shalosh sein beshalosh sein vedinar kelalo shel davar kol halevaa betosefet kol shehu hare zo ribbit shel tora veyotza bedayyanin. vechen hammalve et chavero vehitna immo sheyyadur bachatzero chinnam ad sheyyachzir lo halevaato. o shessachar mimmennu befachot vekatzav haddavar sheppochet lo min hassachar ad sheyyachzir lo halevaato. o shemmishken beyado makom shepperotav metzuyin beet hahalvaa kegon shemmishken chatzero al menat sheyyadur bo bechinnam. hare zo ribbit shel tora veyotza bedayyanin. vechen hammocher sade o chatzer beasmachta hoil velo kana hagguf hare kol happerot sheachal ribbit umachazir otan. vehu haddin lechol mi [shello] kana kinyan gamur mittechilla shehu machzir et happerot mippene sheim achal et happerot hare zo ribbit shel tora. vechol davar shehu asur mishshum ribbit chutz meellu hare hu asur middivrehem gezera shemma yavo leribbit shel tora. vehu hannikra avak ribbit veeno yotze bedayyanin: 
Hammalve et chavero lo yimshoch et avdo kede sheyyaase bo melacha af al pi shehaeved yoshev uvatel. velo yadur bachatzero bechinnam af al pi sheen hechatzer asuya lesachar veen derech baal hechatzer lehasekir. veim dar tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. veim lo heela lo hare ze avak ribbit lefi shello hitna immo sheyyalvehu veyadur bachatzero. lefichach im adayin lo hechzir lo chovo uva lenakkot sechar hechatzer sheddar bah min hachov im haya hassachar keneged hachov eno menakke lo hakkol ella kemo sheyyiru haddayyanim. sheim tesallek oto belo kelum hare ze kemo shehotzi oto bedayyanin vaavak ribbit enah yotza bedayyanin: 
Horu rabbotay shehammalve et chavero uleachar zeman tava chovo veamar lo hallo dur bachatzeri ad sheachzir lecha chovcha hare ze avak ribbit lefi shello katzatz bishat halevaa shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 37)</small> "lo titten lo beneshech": 
Hammalve et chavero al hassade veamar lo im lo tachzir li mikkan ad shalosh shanim hare hi shelli hare ze lo kana mippene shehi asmachta. lefichach menakke kol happerot sheachal mippene shehu ribbit shel tora. aval im amar lo hammocher im lo achzir lecha ad shalosh shanim kene otah meachshav vehevi lo betoch shalosh en lo perot. hevi lo leachar shalosh hare kol happerot lallokeach: 
Hammocher bayit o sade veamar hammocher lallokeach lichsheyyihyu li maot tachzir li karkai lo kana vechol happerot sheachal ribbit ketzutza umotziin otam bedayyanin. aval im amar lo hallokeach middato kesheyyihyu lecha maot ani achzir lecha karka ze muttar vehallokeach ochel perot ad sheyyachzir lo meotav: 
Machar lo et hassade venatan lo miktzat haddamim im amar lo hammocher lallokeach kene keshiur meotecha kol echad mishshenehem ochel perot keshiur meotav. amar hammocher lallokeach lichshettavi shear hammaot tikne meachshav shenehem asurim leechol happerot miyyad. hammocher asur shemma yavi hallokeach shear hammaot venimtzet hassade shello venimtza hammocher ochel perot bishvil hammaot shennisharu lo etzel hallokeach vechen hallokeach asur shemma lo yavi venimtza sheachal bishvil miktzat hammaot sheyyesh lo etzel hammocher. lefichach mannichin et happerot al yede shalish ad sheyyinnatnu leechad mehen. amar lo hammocher lichshettavi shear hammaot tikne hare hammocher ochel perot ad sheyyavi hallokeach veim achal hallokeach motziin mimmennu. amar lo hammocher kene meachshav ushear hammaot hare hen chov etzlecha hare hallokeach ochel perot veim achal hammocher motziin mimmennu kol ma sheachal: 
Horu rabbotay shehammalve et chavero umishken lo sadehu al menat sheyyochal peroteha kol yeme hammashkona af al pi sheeno menakke lo kelum hare zo avak ribbit veenah yotza bedayyanin sheen hamemashken et hassade dome limmashken bayit shehare en bassade perot metzuyin beet hahalvaa veefshar sheyyarviach veyihyu sham perot veefshar sheyyafsid bizriatah vaavodatah ulefichach hi avak ribbit. vechen en hammashkona doma lemi shemmachar beasmachta shehammocher beasmachta lo gamar vehiknahu vehamemashken gamar vehiknahu guf ze leferotav. vechaze yerae min haggemara. shehammashkona avak ribbit veen lecha lehaamidah ella bimmashken sadehu kemo shehoru rabbotay. nimtzeta lamed sheshshalosh mashkonot hen. mashkona shehi ribbit ketzutza. umashkona shehi avak ribbit. umashkona shehi mutteret. ketzad. mishken lo makom shepperotav metzuyin tadir kegon chatzer o merchatz o chanut veachal perotehen hare zo ribbit ketzutza. mishken lo sade vechayyotze bah uvau sham perot vaachalan hare zo avak ribbit. vechen im mishken chatzero vechayyotze bah benikkuy hare ze avak ribbit. mishken sadehu benikkuy hare ze muttar. ketzad hu hannikkuy. kegon shehilvahu mea dinarin umishken lo bahen chatzero o sadehu veamar lo hammalve hareni menakke lecha maa kesef bechol shana bischar karka zo kede sheyyihyu kol perotav shelli bechatzer vechayyotze bah asur uvesade vechayyotze bah muttar: 
Horu miktzat geonim shekkol mashkona sheen bah nikkuy kelal hare hi ribbit ketzutza. velo yardu leomek haddavar lehaferish ben sade lechatzer ulefichach nitkashshu lahen divre chachme haggemara. vechen horu shekkol mashkona afillu benikkuy asur ben bechatzer ben besade veen lahem mashkona mutteret ella badderech hazzot. ketzad. kegon shehilvahu mea dinarin umishken lo bahen bayit o sade vehitna immo sheachar eser shanim tachzor karka zo livaleha chinnam hare ze muttar leechol peroteha kol eser shanim afillu haya secharah shave elef dinarim bechol shana sheen ze ella kemi shessachar befachot. vechen im hitna baal hassade immo kol zeman sheyyavi lo maot yechashev lo eser bechol shana visalleko mimmenna hare ze muttar. vechen im hitna hallo shekkol zeman sheyyirtze mechashshev lo ma sheddar bo veyachzir lo shear haddamim veyistallek hare ze muttar sheen ze ella kischirut vechol tenay shebbischirut muttar kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 7: Hammalve et chavero umishken lo et hassade ad zeman katzuv o ad sheyyavi lo maot veyistallek vehaya hammalve ochel kol peroteha afillu achal keshiur chovo en mesallekin oto belo kelum sheim tesallek oto belo maot hare ze kemi shehotzi mimmennu bedayyanin. veen tzarich lomar sheim achal yeter al meotav en motziin mimmennu. vechen en mechashshevin mishshetar lishtar bemashkona. hayta hakkarka hamemushkenet beyado shel yetomim veachal shiur chovo mesallekin oto belo kelum. aval yeter al chovo en motziin mimmennu hayyeter. umechashshevin lo mishshetar lishtar. ketzad mechashshevin mishshetar lishtar. hare shehayta sade zo memushkenet lo bemea dinar vesade acheret memushkenet lo bishtar acher bemea dinar ushete hassadot leadam echad veachal mipperot hassade haachat bachamishshim umipperot hashsheniyya bemea vachamishshim omrim lo hare achalta min happerot bematayim veen lecha kelum ucheillu hashshene shetarot shetar echad umashkona achat:

Makom shennahagu lesallek hammalve kol zeman sheyyavi lo maot hare ze kemo shepperesh veen tzarich lefaresh davar ze. vechen makom shennahagu shello yistallek hammalve ad sof zeman hammashkona hare ze kemo shepperesh. vechol hamemashken setam eno yachol lesalleko ad shenem asar chodesh:

Makom sheddarkan lesallek hammalve kol zeman sheyyirtze hallo vehitna immo hammalve shello yistallek ad sof zeman hammashkona hare ze eno yachol lesalleko. haya hamminhag sheen hammalve mistallek ad sof zemanno vekibbel hammalve alav sheyyistallek bechol et sheyyavi lo meotav hare ze tzarich liknot miyyado al kach:

Hammashkona bemakom shemminhagam lesallek hammalve bechol et sheyyavi meotav en baal chov shel malve gove mimmenna kederech sheggove min hakkarka. veen habbechor notel bah pi shenayim. usheviit meshammattah. ucheshemmesallek oto eno notel afillu perot shebbashlu venaflu laaretz. veim higbiah otan kodem sheyyesalleku kana otan. umakom sheeno yachol lesalleko ad sof zemanno baal chov gove hemennu. vehabbechor notel pi shenayim. veen hashsheviit meshammatta:

Af al pi shemmashkona zo asura hi vaavak ribbit kemo shebbearnu. efshar sheyyihye minhag ze betaut o laakkum o derech kol mi shechote umishken beotah medina hoil vaavak ribbit holchin achar hamminhag. veyesh mi shehora shezzot hammashkona benikkuy:

Akkum shemmishken chatzero leyisrael vechazar haakkum umecharah leyisrael acher en hamemashken chayyav lehaalot sachar leyisrael meet shekkana hayyisrael ella dar bechatzer belo sachar ad sheyyachzir lo haakkum et hammaot sheyyesh lo al chatzer zo shehare hu birshut hamemashken bedinehem ad sheyyitten lo meotav veyistallek:

Hamemashken bayit o sade beyad chavero vehaya baal hakkarka ochel peroteha veamar lo hammalve lichshettimkor karka zo lo timkerenna ella li bedamim ellu hare ze asur. veim amar lo al timkerenna ella li beshavyah veal menat ken ani malve otcha hare ze muttar:

Muttar leharebot bischar hakkarka. ketzad. hiskir lo et hechatzer veamar lo im meachshav atta noten li hare hi lecha beeser selaim bechol shana. veim titten sechar chodesh bechodesh hare hi besela bechol chodesh. hare ze muttar:

Hammaskir sade lachavero baasara korim leshana. veamar lo ten li matayim zuz sheafarnes bahen et hassade vaani etten lecha shenem asar kor bechol shana. hare ze muttar mippene sheim yefarnes et hassade bedinarin ellu yihye secharah yoter. vechen im hiskir lo chanut o sefina baasara dinarin beshana veamar lo ten li matayim zuz sheevne bahen chanut vaatzayyerenna vaachayyerenna o atakken bahen sefina zo uchele tashmisheha vaani aale lecha shenem asar dinar bechol shana hare ze muttar. aval im amar lo ten li matayim zuz kede lehitassek bahen bachanut o otziem bischora shel sefina o eskor bahen mallachin vaani aale lecha besachar hare ze asur:
Asur leharebot bischar haadam. ketzad. lo yomar lo ase immi hayyom melacha zo shehi shava kesef vaani eese immecha beshavua acher melacha shehi shava shetayim:

Muttar laadam lomar lachavero nakkesh immi hayyom vaanakkesh immecha lemachar ador immi hayyom veeedor immecha lemachar. aval lo yomar lo nakkesh immi veeedor immecha ador immi vaanakkesh immecha. kol yeme garid echad vechol yeme revia achat. velo yomar lo charosh immi begarid vaani echerosh immecha birvia. shehare torach hacharisha bimot haggeshamim yater. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hassocher et happoel bime hachoref laasot immo bime hakkor bedinar bechol yom venatan lo hassachar vahare secharo shave bime hachoref sela bechol yom hare ze asur mippene shennire kemalve oto hayyom kede sheyyozil lo bischaro. aval im amar lo ase immi mehayyom vead zeman peloni bedinar bechol yom af al pi sheshshave secharo sela bechol yom hare ze muttar hoil vehu matchil laasot meatta eno nire kenotel sechar meotav shehikdim unetanan lo bischaro:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 8:
Asur leharebot al hammecher. ketzad. hammocher lachavero karka o mittaltelin veamar lo im meachshav titten li haddamim hare hen shellecha bemea veim ad zeman peloni hare hem shellecha beesrim umea. hare ze avak ribbit shezze dome kemi shennotel esrim bishvil shennatan lo mea lehishtammesh bah ad zeman peloni uchesheyyitbaennu baddin eno chayyav litten ella ma shehaya shave bishat hammecher o yachzir mimkaro miyyado im haya kayyam. vechen im machar lo mittaltelin ad zeman peloni bemea vehayu shavin bashshuk lemi shekkone bimotav miyyad tishim hare ze asur. veeno noten lo ella tishim o machzir miyyado sechorato im hayta kayyemet: 
Hallokeach mechavero chefetz beshavehu al menat sheyyitten lo mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh. hare ze rashshay lomar lo ten [li] miyyad befachot veeno choshesh mishshum ribbit: 
Chavit shel yayin shehi shava atta dinar umecharah lo bishnayim ad hakkayitz al menat sheim teera bah takkala hare hi birshut hammocher ad sheyyimkerenna hallokeach hare ze muttar. sheim avda o nishbera eno meshallem kelum. veim lo matza lemachrah uleharviach bah haya lo lehachezirah labbealim. vechen im mecharah lo bishnayim veamar lo hayyater al shenayim yihye secharcha bishvil sheatta metappel lemachrah veim lo timtza lemachrah kemo shettirtze hachazirah li hare ze muttar. af al pi sheim avda o nigneva o hechmitza tihye birshut hallokeach: 
Hayu lo perot sheim yirtze lemachran bashshuk velikkach demehen miyyad mochran baasara. veim tava otan hallokeach liknotan veyitten hammaot miyyad yikne otan bishnem asar. hare ze muttar lemachran bishnem asar ad shenem asar chodesh. sheafillu hevi ze meotav atta bishnem asar haya kone otan. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Asur liknot peri happardes kodem sheyyiggamer veyitbashshel. mippene shezze shemmocher bezol atta beeser hu peri sheshshave esrim kesheyyiggamer. nimtzet hattosefet bishvil hahakkafa. aval im kana egel bezol vehaya etzel habbealim ad sheyyagdil hare ze muttar shehare im met o kachash birshut hallokeach hu vehakkachash vehammita davar matzuy tamid: 
Hannoten maot levaal hakkerem al hassarigim veal hazzemorot lichsheyyikkartu shehem beyoker vehu kone otan bezol ad sheyyivshu veyikkartu hare ze tzarich lehappech bahen keshehem mechubbarim shennimtza kekone ilan lizmorotav. veim lo hafach nimtzeu hammaot halevaa vehen lokchin bezol mippene hahakkafa veasur: 
Shomre hassadot shennotnin lahem chittim bischaran bezol min haggoren. kesheyyavou laggoren tzerichin lehitassek immahen bimlacha baggoren kede sheyyihyu hachittim haellu shennatlu besof zeman hassechirut. veim lo asu kach nimtzet hassechirut etzel habbealim kemilve veze shellakchu bezol mippene sheicharu secharan ad haggoren: 
Arisin shehayu baale hassadot mesallekin otan min hassade benisan venotnin lahem haarisin bechol zera chomer arba sein vehinniach ze arisin betoch sadehu ad iyyar venatal mehen shesh sein hare ze muttar veen sham ribbit: 
Hallokeach chittim arba sein besela vechen hashshaar venatan lo et hammaot ucheshebba ligbot et hachittim leachar zeman hosif lo bammidda venatan lo yeter. hare ze muttar shehare birtzono hosif lo veillu ratza lo hosif shehare lo haya sham tenay: 
Muttar leadam litten deme chavit shel yayin lachavero velomar lo im hechmitza mikkan ad yom peloni birshutecha aval im hozila o hokira hare hi shelli. shekkevan shekkibbel alav hazzol hare ze karov lesachar ulehefsed. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen muttar leadam liknot mechavero betishre mea kaddin shel yayin bedinar veeno notlan ad tevet. ucheshennotlan bodek umachazir hachometz velokeach hayyayin hattov. shello kana mimmennu ella yayin tov veellu shehechmitzu mittechilla hayu reuyin lehachemitz aval lo noda haddavar ad achar hazzeman: 
Makom shennahagu liskor hassefina velittol secharah veim nishbera shamin lo ma sheppachata umeshallem yeter al secharah hare ze muttar. vechen muttar lehasekir sir shel nechoshet vechayyotze bo venotel hassachar udeme ma sheppachat mimmishkalo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
