En mekabbelin tzon barzel miyyisrael mippene shehu avak ribbit. vechetzad hen tzon barzel. hare shehaya lo mea tzon vekibbelam mimmennu lehittappel bahen veyihyu haggizzot vehavveladot vehechalav laemtza lishlish o lirvia ad shana o ad shenatayim kemo shehitnu benehem veim metu hatztzon hare hamekabbel meshallem demehem hare ze asur shehare baal hatztzon karov lesachar verachok lehefsed. lefichach im kibbel alav baal hatztzon sheim hukeru o huzelu o im nitrefu hare hen birshuto hare ze muttar. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hashsham para mechavero veamar lo im meta hare hi atta alay bishloshim dinarim vaani aale lecha sela bechol chodesh muttar lefi shello asaah mechayyim damim ella leachar mita: 
Maskeret ishsha lachavertah tarnegolet leshev al habbetzim bishne efrochim veen choshshin mishshum ribbit: 
Mi shehaya noshe bachavero arbaa dinarim shel ribbit venatan lo bahen chefetz sheshshave chamishsha keshemmotziin mimmennu motziin mimmennu chamishsha hoil uvetorat ribbit ba leyado. vechen im natan lo bahen kesut o keli motziin mimmennu et hakkeli atzmo veoto hakkesut atzmo. hiskir lo bahen makom sheshshave secharo shelosha dinarin keshemmotziin mimmennu motziin mimmennu arbaa shehare bearbaa sachar mimmennu makom ze shekkibbel alav:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 9:
En poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar. yatza hashshaar poskin. af al pi sheen laze yesh laze. ketzad. haya hashshaar lachittim kavua lashshuk arba sein besela hare ze posek immo al mea sein venoten lo chamesh veesrim selaim. veim yitten lo mea sea shel chittim achar zeman beet sheyyihyu hachittim sea besela en baze ribbit kelal af al pi shello haya lammocher chittim kelal beet sheppasak. bamme devarim amurim beshello haya lo kelum meoto hammin beet sheppasak alav. aval im haya lammocher meoto hammin kelum af al pi sheadayin lo nigmera melachto hare ze muttar lifsok alav af al pi sheadayin lo yatza hashshaar. ketzad. haya hu techilla lakkotzrim hare ze posek al hachittim af al pi sheadayin hen gadish. ufosek al hayyayin mishsheyyivtzor haanavim veyittenem beavit veal hashshemen mishshennatan zetim bammaatan veal hassid mishsheyyeshakkeenna bakkivshan. vechen posek al kele cheres mishsheyyaase hayyotzer betzim shellahen. bamme devarim amurim beshehaya afaran lavan aval afaran shachor posek al hakkelim hannaasin mimmennu af al pi shello naasu mippene shehu matzuy lakkol veaf al pi sheen laze yesh laze. vechen posek immo al hazzevel kol yemot hashshana af al pi sheen lo zevel mippene shehu matzuy tamid: 
Kol davar shehu mechussar melacha achat o shetayim posek immo alav. haya mechussar shalosh melachot eno posek ella im ken yatza hashshaar shekkevan shehu mechussar shalosh melachot hare ze kemi sheen lo meoto hammin kelum uchemo lo ba laolam adayin. ketzad. gadish shehaya mechussar hannacha bashshemesh sheyyivash vedisha uzeriyya eno posek alav ella im ken yatza hashshaar. haya yavesh veeno mechussar ella disha uzeriyya posek alav. betzim shel yotzer shehayu mechussarin lefifa veyibbush veholacha lakkivshan userefa vehotzaa eno posek alehen. hayu yeveshin veenan mechussarin ella holacha lakkivshan userefa posek alehen. vehu sheyyihye derech hallokeach lehotzi oto min hakkivshan. aval im haya hammocher hu shemmotzi hare ellu mechussarin shalosh veeno posek alehen ad sheyyetze hashshaar. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haholech lachalov et izzav veligzoz et rechelav velirdot et kavvarto umetzao chavero veamar lo ma sheizzay cholvot machur lecha ma sherchelay gozzot machur lecha ma shekkavvarti roda machur lecha hare ze muttar. aval amar lo ma sheizzay cholvot kach vechach machur lecha bechach vechach. ma sherchelay gozzot kach vechach machur lecha bechach vechach. ma shekkavvarti roda kach vechach machur lecha bechach vechach asur ella im ken pasak immo kashshaar shebbashshuk. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
En poskin al shaar shel ayarot mippene sheen hashshaar kavua ella al shaar shebbammedina. hayu hachittim hachadashot bammedina arba sein besela vishanot shalosh besela en poskin ad sheyyetze hashshaar lechadash velayyashan. hayu chittin shel lekutot arba sein besela veshel baal habbayit shalosh posek lallekutot keshaar lekutot velo yifsok levaal habbayit ad sheyyikba hashshaar levaal habbayit: 
Kevan shennikba hashshaar muttar lifsok al hashshaar haggavoah. ketzad. hayu hachittim nimkarot arba sein besela ufasak immo sheyyitten lo hachittim kashshaar hazzol im amdu achar ken eser sein besela noten lo eser sein kashshaar shehaya bashshuk shehare pasak immo beshaar gavoah. natan lo hammaot setam velo pasak immo bashshaar haggavoah vehuzelu noten kashshaar shehayu shavin keshennatan lo hammaot. umi shechazar mekabbel mi sheppara. bamme devarim amurim befosek al daat atzmo. aval im haya shaliach laacherim ben hammocher ben hallokeach eno notel ella kashshaar hazzol o machzir et haddamim veeno mekabbel mi sheppara beshaliach shehare hameshalleach omer letakken shelachticha velo leavvet kemo shebbearnu: 
Hayu hachittim nimkarot arba sein besela venatal et haddamim venatan lo chamesh besela im yesh lo chittim muttar. hayu lo chittim chov etzel acherim venatal hammaot ad sheyyigbe chittav veyitten lo asur shehare hen mechussarin geviyya ucheillu enam vahare ze kekovea lo zeman vehozil lo mippene shemmakkifo: 
Hayu hachittim bammedina arba sein besela uvakkefarim shesh bassela hare ze muttar litten sela letaggar kede sheyyavi shesh sein min hakkefar. vehu sheyyihyu birshut hallokeach. im avdu badderech o nignevu avdu lo. veadam chashuv asur laasot ze. vbmine sechora asur lechol adam lefi sheen mine sechora metzuyin keferot: 
Hachammarin shennichnesu lair vahare hachittim arba sein besela. hozilu umachru lemakkirehen o lesafsarehen chamesh besela bammaot shennatnu lahen techilla kesheyyikkansu lair ad sheyyiftechu sakkehen veyimkeru lechol adam hare ze muttar sheen ellu mochrin lahem bezol mippene shennatnu maot atta velo yikchu ella leachar zeman ella mippene shemmodiin lahem et hashshaar umesaadin otam: 
Hammolich perotav mimmakom lemakom metzao chavero veamar lo tenem li vaani aale lecha perot sheyyesh li (bemakom peloni) beoto makom. im yesh lo sham muttar veim lav asur. haya molich sechora mimmakom lemakom amar lo tenem li vaani aale lecha dameha kemo sheshshave beoto makom im hayta birshut hammocher ad shehiggia lesham muttar veim hayta birshut lokeach asur: 
Hannoten levaal hagginna deme asara kishshuin ellu deme asara avattichim ellu vahare hen ketannim vehitna immo sheyyittenem lo lichsheyyagdilu hare ze muttar shehare hu mannichan vehem gedelim mealehen veillu kitztzetzan atta keshehen ketannim lo hayu baim acherim tachtehen. vechen kol kayyotze baze middavar sheen bo hefsed velo chissaron al hammocher:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 10:
Keshem shemmuttar lammocher lifsok al shaar shebbashshuk kach muttar lilvot happerot setam uforin setam belo keviat zeman al hashshaar shebbashshuk. ketzad. haya hashshaar kavua veyadua lishnehem velava mechavero eser sein chayyav lehachezir lo eser sein af al pi shehukeru hachittim shehare keshellava mimmennu haya hashshaar yadua veillu ratza haya kone umachazir lo shehare lo kava lo zeman: 
Haya lo meoto hammin shellava hare ze muttar lilvot setam belo keviat zeman uforea setam af al pi sheadayin lo yatza hashshaar. vaafillu hayta lo sea bilvad lo aleha kamma sein. hayta lo tippa achat shel shemen o shel yayin lo aleha kamma garbe yayin veshemen. lo hayta lo meoto hammin kelum velo nikba shaar hashshuk adayin o shello yadu shaar hashshuk hare ze asur lilvot sea bisa. vechen bishar happerot lo yalve otan ad sheyyaase otan damim. veim lava velo asa otan [damim] vehuzelu machzir lo perot kammidda shellava o kammishkal. veim hukar notel damim shehayu shavin bishat halevaa. af al pi sheyyesh lo meoto hammin o shehaya hashshaar kavua bashshuk hare ze asur lilvot perot beferot ad zeman kavua ella lo setam uforea beeze zeman sheyyifra: 
Lo yomar adam lachavero haleveni kor chittim vaani achzir lecha kor laggoren ella omer lo haleveni ad sheyyavo beni o ad sheemtza hammafteach: 
Lava perot ad zeman kavua im huzelu machzir lo perot bazzeman shekkava veim hukeru noten lo damim shehayu shavin bishat hahalvaa: 
Malve adam et arisav chittim bechittim lezera ben kodem sheyyarad haaris lassade ben achar sheyyarad. bamme devarim amurim bemakom shennahagu sheyyitten haaris et hazzera shehare beyad baal hakkarka lesalleko kol zeman shello natan. aval bemakom shedderech baal hakkarka litten et hazzera im adayin lo yarad haaris hare ze muttar lehalevot chittim bechittim sheadayin yesh lo lesalleko nimtza beet sheyyarad lassade yarad al daat sheyyachzir lo chittim shehilvahu. aval achar sheyyarad lassade hoil veeno yachol lesalleko hare hu kechol adam veasur lehalevoto chittim bachittim lezera aval malvehu setam al shaar shebbashshuk: 
Mi shehaya noshe bachavero maot veamar lo ten li meotay sheani rotze likkach bahen chittim. amar lo tze vaase otan alay keshaar shel achshav veyihye lecha etzli chittim behalevaa. im yesh lo chittim keshiur meotav muttar veim en [lo] oto hammin hare ze asur. shello amru chachamim shemmuttar lifsok al shaar shebbashshuk af al pi sheen lo kelum meoto hammin ella benoten meotav liknot bahen perot. aval harotze lehaamid halevaato al gav happerot asur ad sheyyihyu lo perot. haya lallo chittim veasa halevaato alav chittim uva achar zeman veamar lo ten li chittim sheani rotze lemachran velikkach bidmehen yayin. amar lo tze vaase otan alay yayin kashshaar shebbashshuk atta. im yesh lo yayin hare ze muttar venaaset halevaato etzlo yayin veim en lo yayin asur. hare shello haya lo veavar vehechzir hahalvaa perot af al pi shekkana perot achar kach eno chayyav litten lo perot ella noten lo maot shehilvahu:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 11:
Hammalve et chavero bifonoy edim o sheamar leedim heyu alay edim sheani chayyav laze mane o attem eday sheani chayyav laze mane. zo nikret milve al pe veen tzarich lefaro beedim. lefichach im taan veamar achar kach parati nishba hesset veniftar. aval hammalve et chavero bishtar tzarich lefaro beedim lefichach im taan veamar parati shetar ze eno neeman ella omrim lo o have edim o amod veshallem lo chovo. lefichach haomer leedim heyu alay edim sheani chayyav laze mane en kotvin edutan venotnin lammalve. shello yachaziro lammalve al pi edut bishtar ad sheyyomar lahen hallo kitvu shetar vechitmu utenu lo. af al pi sheamar lahen kach tzerichin lehimmalech bo achar shechatmu bashshetar veachar kach notnin hashshetar beyad hammalve. kanu miyyado shehu chayyav lo mane hare ellu kotvin venotnin af al pi shello amar lahen ketovu shessetam kinyan lichtiva omed veenan tzerichin lehimmalech bo: 
Lo shekkatav shetar bichtav yado veheid bo edim unetano lammalve hare ze shetar kasher. vechen im katav shetar af al pi sheen bo edim unetano lammalve bifne edim hare zo milve bishtar. vehu sheyyihye ketav sheeno yachol lehizdayyef veyikreu oto haedim shennimsar bifnehem. veyesh min haggeonim shehora shetztzarich lomar laedim shemmasru bifnehem chitmu vehaidu shennimsar bifnechem: 
Hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyav lo veen sham edim af al pi shehuchzak ketav yado bevet din hare ze kemilve al pe lechol davar. veim taan sheppara nishba hesset veniftar veeno gove bichtav ze lo min hayyorshin velo min hallakochot: 
Kol milve bishtar gove otah min hayyorshin umin hallakochot kemo sheyyitbaer. umilve al pe gove otah min hayyorshin veeno gove otah min hallakochot lefi sheen lah kol lefichach lo yitrof bah. aval milve shebbishtar kol yesh lah vehallokeach hifsid al atzmo shello shaal ad sheyyada shennechasav shel ze meshubadin bammilve shealav. shekkol nichse hallo tachat shibud hammalve min hattora: 
Hammocher sadehu beedim veyatzat mittachat yede hallokeach af al pi sheen sham shetar beyad hallokeach hare ze chozer vetoref minnechasim meshubadim kemo sheyyitbaer. shekkol hammocher befarhesya mocher vekol yesh lo: 
En hahalvaa sheal pe nigbet min hayyorshin ella beechad mishshelosha devarim ellu. keshechayyav mode bah vetzivva bechalyo sheyyesh lifloni alav chov adayin. o shehayta hahalvaa lizman velo higgia zeman lefarah vachazaka hi sheen adam porea betoch zemanno. o shennidduhu ad sheyyitten umet benidduyo. kol ellu govin min hayyorshin belo shevua. aval im bau edim shehaya chayyav laze mane o befanenu hilvahu eno gove min hayyoresh kelum shemma perao shehammalve et chavero beedim en tzarich lefaro beedim. vechen im motzi ketav yad avihen shehu chayyav lo eno gove bo kelum kemo shebbearnu: 
Lo sheen lo mittaltelin veyesh lo karka im noda levet din shettole meotav beyad acherim kofin oto limkor velitten levaal chovo. veim lo noda lahem davar ze machrimin al mi sheyyeda lo mittaltelin velo yeviem. veachar kach yordin levenonit shebbinchasav umagbin levaal chovo kemo sheyyitbaer. bamme devarim amurim bizman shennifrain min hallo atzmo. aval habba lippara min hayyoresh ben katan ben gadol lo yippara min hammittaltelin afillu hayu mufkadin o milve etzel acherim. shehammittaltelin enan tachat shibud baal chov min hattora: 
Mitzva al hayetomin lifroa chov avihen min hammittaltelin shehinniach. veim lo ratza hayyoresh litten en kofin oto. veim tafas baal chov mechayyim gove mehen. taan shemmechayyim tefasan vehayyoresh taan sheachar mita tafas al hayyoresh lehavi reaya o yishshava hammalve shekkach vechach hu chayyav lo veyachol liton ad kede demehen vecholel bishvuato shemmechayyim tafas. hayu haddevarim shettafas shetarot vetaan shehen mashkon beyado al chovo veshemmechayyim tafas. al hammalve lehavi reaya shemmechayyim tafas. veim lo hevi reaya yachzir layyorshim mippene sheeno toen liknot gufam ella laraya shebbahen: 
Yetomim sheggavu karka bechov shehaya laavihen etzel acherim yesh levaal chov shel avihem lachzor veligbot otah mehen shehare karka zo shel avihem hi: 
Reuven shemmachar sade leshimon beacharayut vezakaf shimon deme hassade alav milve liruven umet reuven uva baal chov shel reuven litrof mishshimon hassade ufiyyeso shimon bemaot vehalach lo. haddin noten sheyyavou yorshe reuven veyitbeu shimon bammilve shezzakaf alav shehare enah meshubedet levaal chov shel reuven. lefichach im haya shimon pikkeach noten lahen hakkarka shellakach meruven bammilve shezzakaf al atzmo vechozer vetoref otah mehen mippene hammaot shennatan levaal chov shel reuven kede shello yitrof otah mimmennu shehare beacharayut lekachah meruven: 
Kevar tikkenu geonim haacharonim kullam sheyyihye baal chov gove mittaltelin min hayyorshin. vechen danin yisrael bechol bet din shebbaolam. aval bammaarav hayu kotvin beshitre chovot sheyyesh ligbot min hakkarka umin hammittaltelin ben bechayyav ben achar moto venimtza gove al tenay ze yoter min hattakkana. useyag gadol asu baddavar shemma lo yeda hallo betakkana zo venimtza mamon yetomim yotze shello kaddin. sheen koach betakkanat acharonim lechayyev bah yetomim:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 12:
En nifrain min hayyorshin ella im ken hayu gedolim. aval yorshin ketannim en nifrain mehen shetar chov: 
Vaafillu haya bo kol tenay shebbaolam lo yippara bo hammalve kelum ad sheyyagdilu hayetomim shemma yesh lahen reaya sheshshovrin bah et hashshetar: 
Hayta hammilve ribbit shel akkum shehare haribbit ochelet benichsehen maamidin lahem appotroppos venizkakin lenichsehen umochrin uforin hachov. vechen ishsha shettava ketubbatah ben almana ben gerusha maamidim lahem appotroppos venizkakin mishshum chen haishsha kede sheyyihye lah kelum shettinnase bo haishsha leacher. lefichach im kaftza haishsha venisset veachar kach bat litboa ketubbatah minnichse yetomim en nizkakin lah ad sheyyigdelu hayetomim shehare en lah mezonot vahare nisset: 
Horu miktzat haggeonim sheim hayu hannechasim keneged hakketubba bilvad o pechutim mimmenna en nizkakin lah shehare en kan zechut laytomim shello amru nizkakin lenichse yetomim lehippara mehen hakketuva ella kede shello yifchatu hannechasim mechamat hammezonot vezot hoil vehi notelet hakkol ma zechut yesh laytomim hakketannim bedavar ze ad shennizkakin lahen. velo chashu lechen haishsha: 
Tzivva hammorishan veamar tenu mane lifloni nizkakin achar shemmaamidin lahen appotroppos liton taanatam. amar tenu mane ze lifloni o sade zo lifloni notnin veen tzerichim lehaamid lahen appotroppos: 
Nimtzet karka sheenah shellahen ella taan hattoen shehi gezel beyad morishav nizkakin lahen umaamidim lahen appotroppos liton veladun. im nimtzet gezula machzirim otah livaleha. vechen katan shettakaf baavadav veyarad letoch sede chavero uchevashah en omrin namtin lo ad sheyyagdil ella motziin otah miyyado velichsheyyagdil im yesh lo edim yavi edav: 
Karka shehayta bechezkat ketannim uva acher vetaan shehi lekucha mimmorishan veyesh lo edim shehechzik bah vaachalah shene chazaka bechayye avihen en motziin otah miyyadan ad sheyyagdilu sheen mekabbelin edim shello bifne baal din vehakkatan keillu eno omed kan hu chashuv. aval im hotzi shetar shehi lekucha beyado hare ze mekayyem et hashshetar umotziin otah miyyadan achar shemmaamidim lahem appotroppos: 
Keshennizkakin bet din lenichse yetomim limkor shamin et hakkarka veachar kach machrizin aleha sheloshim yom retzufin o shishshim yom sheni vachamishi. umachrizim babboker uvaerev bishat hachenasat poalim uvishat hotzaat poalin vechol mi sherotze liknot yolich happoalin levakker lo. uveshaa shemmachrizin mesayyemim et hassade bimtzareha umodiin kamma yafa uvechamma hu shuma umippene ma rotzim lemachrah im lehagebot levaal chov o lichtubbat ishsha lefi sheyyesh mi sherotze litten levaal chov veyesh mi sherotze lehagebot leishsha: 
Ucheshekkotvin haadrachta al nichse yetomim ben gedolim ben ketannim kotvin bah vehikkarnu shehannechasim haellu hen shel peloni hammet. veim lo katvu kach hare adrachta zo pesula veen ochlin bah perot afillu leachar sheshshalmu hahachrazot: 
Bet din shemmachru shello behacheraza naasu kemi shettau bidvar mishna vechozrim umochrin behacheraza. uvet din shemmachru haacharayut al hayetomim: 
Uvet din shehichrizu karauy uvadku yafe yafe vedikdeku bashshuma af al pi shettau umachru sheve mane bematayim o matayim bemane hare michran kayyam. aval im lo badku bashshuma velo katvu iggeret bikkoret shehi dikduk hashshuma vehahachraza vetau vehotiru shetut o pachatu shetut michran batel. pachot mishshetut michran kayyam. vechen im machru karka beet sheenan tzerichin lehacheriz aleha vetau shetut o hotiru shetut michran batel af al pi shehichrizu. pachot mishshetut michran kayyam af al pi shello hichrizu sheenan tzerichin hacheraza beoto haet. ezehu haet sheenan tzerichin hacheraza beet sheyyimkeru karka likvura o limzon haishsha vehabbanot o litten menat hammelech en tzerichin hacheraza lefi shehaddavar nachutz. vechen bet din shemmachru devarim sheenan teunin hacheraza vetau bishtut michran batel. pachot mishshetut michran kayyam. veellu hen haddevarim sheen machrizin alehem haavadim vehashshetarot vehammittaltelin. haavadim shemma yishmeu veyivrechu. vehashshetarot vehammittaltelin shemma yigganvu. lefichach shamin otan bevet din umochrin otan miyyad. veim hashshuk karov lammedina molichin otan lashshuk:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 13: Malve shebba lehippara bashshetar shebbeyado shello bifne lo im yecholin bet din lishloach elav ulehodio ad sheyyaamod immo baddin sholchin umodiin lo. veim i efshar lehodio bimhera omrim lammalve sheyyishshava veyittol minnechasav ben min hakkarka ben min hammittaltelim. veen choshshin leshover. vedin ze takkanat chachamim hu kede shello yihye kol echad veechad notel meotav shel chavero veholech veyoshev lo bimdina acheret venimtza noel delet bifne loyn:

Shalosh reayot tzarich lehavi levet din veachar kach yippara shello befanav. reaya rishona lekayyem hashshetar shebbeyado. reaya sheniyya shebbaal chovo bimdina acheret veeno matzuy bechan laamod immo baddin. reaya shelishit sheellu nechasim shel peloni hallo hem:

Malve shebba levet din vehevi mashkon beyado veamar ze mashkono shel peloni hu vaani rotze lemachro ulehippara chovi. en bet din nizkakin lomar lo hameten ad sheyyavo lo veyiton sheim rotze lomar lakuach hu beyadi omer umassiin lo etza lemachro bifne edim kede sheyyeda lo bechamma nimkar. vechen hammalve et chavero al hammashkon umet hallo vehammalve ben shemmet hallo techilla ben shemmet malve techilla hoil vehu nifra mimma shettachat yado veillu ratza lomar lakuach hu beyadi omer hare ze nishba binkitat chefetz venotel kederech kol hannishbain venotlin. umippene ma eno nishba hesset lefi sheeno nishba al atzmo shel mashkon ella al hammamon shellokeach. sheillu amar al atzmo shel chefetz ze atta mecharto li atta netatto li haya nishba hesset veniftar. aval im hayu sham edim shechefetz ze mashkon beyado velo yadu al kamma vechamma eno yachol littol ella bishvua vehoil veen sham edim veyachol lomar shelli hu neeman lomar yesh li alav kach vechach bashshevua atzmah shehaya nishba im hayu sham edim shehu mashkon. sheen omrin miggo lefatro mishshevua ella lefatro mimmamon shello yachzir hammashkon ad sheyyittol ma shettaan:

Hammalve et chavero al hammashkon veavad o nignav belo ones shehare hammalve chayyav bidme hammashkon kemo shebbearnu. veamar hammalve sela hilveticha alav ushene dinarin haya shave. velo omer sela hilvetani alav vesela haya shave. hare hammalve nishba techilla shevuat hashshomrin sheeno birshuto vehallo nishba hesset shehaya shave keneged hachov veniftar. amar hammalve sela hilveticha alav veshekel haya shave vehallo omer sela hilvetani alav ushelosha dinarin haya shave yishshava hammalve techilla sheeno birshuto veachar kach yishshava hallo kamma haya shave shehare hoda bemiktzat vishallem haddinar. amar hallo sela hilvetani alav ushetayim haya shave vehammalve omer sela hilveticha alav vesela haya shave yishshava hammalve sheeno birshuto vecholel bishvuato shehaya hammashkon keneged hachov. amar hallo sela hilvetani alav ushetayim haya shave vehammalve omer sela hilveticha alav vachamishsha dinarin haya shave yishshava hammalve sheeno birshuto veyichlol shello haya shave yeter al chamishsha dinarim vishallem haddinar. sela hilveticha alav ushene dinarin haya shave vehallo omer eni yodea damav yishshava malve sheeno birshuto vecholel bishvuato sheshshene dinarin haya shave vishallem hallo shear hachov shehare hu yodea bevadday shehu chayyav lo veeno yodea im perao im lo perao. sela hilvetani alav ushetayim haya shave vehammalve omer eni yodea damav yishshava hammalve sheeno birshuto veyichlol sheeno yodea sheddamav yeter al hachov afillu peruta achat veyippater shehare lo chiyyev atzmo bichlum. aval im amar hammalve ani yodea shehaya shave yeter al hachov aval eni yodea kamma hare ze meshallem kol ma shettaan hallo belo shevua kemi sheamar chamishshim yesh lecha beyadi vachamishshim eni yodea shehu mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lehishshava kemo sheyyitbaer. veyesh lo lehacharim al mi shettoen sheker:

Hammalve et chavero vekava lo zeman lefaro af al pi shello kanu miyyado eno yachol letavo ad sof hazzeman ben bemilve al pe ben bemilve bishtar ben shehilvahu al hammashkon ben shemmet lo ben shemmet malve. usetam milve sheloshim yom ben bishtar ben al pe ben al hammashkon. veim hitna sheyyitba bechol zeman sheyyirtze yesh lo letavo beyomo shettenay mamon hu:

Taan hammalve veamar hayyom sof hazzeman shekkavati vehallo omer ad asara yamim kavata hallo nishba hesset. veim haya sham ed echad shehayyom sof zemanno hare ze nishba shevuat hattora kishar hatteanot. ze omer chamishsha yamim nishar min hazzeman veze omer asara omrim lammalve hameten od ad sof hachamishsha veyishshava hesset shennishar od chamishsha yamim:
Hayta hammilve bishtar vetaan hallo shezzeman kavata li. yerae li sheyyishshava baal chov hesset shello kava lo zeman veyittol hammalve miyyad:

Hammilve nittena littava bechol makom. ketzad. hammalve et chavero bayyishshuv utevao bammidbar eno yachol lidchoto ella chayyav lifroa lo bechol makom sheyyitbaennu. ba hallo lefaro bammidbar harshut beyad hammalve im ratza mekabbel veim ratza omer lo eni nifra ella bayyishshuv kederech shennatatti lecha beyishshuv. vahare hen birshuto ad sheyyifraennu bayyishshuv:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 14: Happogem et shetaro. o sheed echad meid al shetaro shehu parua. vehabba lippara shello bifne hallo. vehattoref miyyad hallokeach. vehannifraim min hayyoresh ben katan ben gadol. lo yippara ella bishvua keen shel tora. (veomer) lo kesheyyitba hishshava veachar kach tittol. veim haya hachov lizman vetava bizmanno yippara shello bishvua. avar zemanno lo yigbe ella bishvua:

Hattovea et chavero lefaro vetaan hallo sheppara shetar ze o miktzato uvaal hashshetar omer lo parata kelum omrim lo shallem lo. taan hallo veamar yishshava li shello perativ veyittol mashbiin oto binkitat chefetz shello perao kelum o shello perao ella kach vechach veachar kach yittol. veim haya hammalve talmid chacham en nizkakin lishvuato:

Hotzi alav shetar mekuyyam vehallo toen veomer shetar mezuyyaf hu umeolam lo katavti shetar ze. o shettaan shechov ze ribbit hu o avak ribbit. o shettaan shehu shetar amana o sheamar katavti lilvot velo laviti. kelalo shel davar toen taana sheim hoda baal hashshetar haya hashshetar batel vehammalve omed bishtaro veomer shezze sheker toen veamar hallo yishshava li veyittol hare zo machloket ben haggeonim yesh mi shehora shechayyav baal hashshetar lehishshava keen shel tora kemi shettaan alav shepperao. verabbotay horu shello yishshava hammalve ella im taan alav hallo shepperao bilvad. shehare hoda bashshetar uleferaon hu omed. aval kol ellu hatteanot lo kol hemennu levattel shetar mekuyyam ella yeshallem veachar kach yiton al hammalve bema sheyyirtze sheim yode yachzir lo veim kafar yishshava hesset. velaze dati nota:

Hammotzi shetar chov al chavero malve omer lo nifrati kelum velo omer parati mechetza vehaedim meidim shepperao kullo nishba hallo venoten mechetza shehare hoda bemiktzat veeno kemeshiv aveda mippene sheemat hashshetar alav. veen hammalve gove hammechetza ella mibbene chorin shehare hallakochot omrim anu al haedim nismoch vahare bittelu shetar ze:

Hotzi alav shetar chov sheeno yachol lekayyemo veamar hallo emet sheani katavti shetar ze aval perativ o amana hu o katavti lilvot vaadayin lo laviti vechol kayyotze baze hoil veim ratza amar lo hayu devarim meolam vahare mippiv nitkayyem hare ze neeman veyishshava hesset veyippater. veim kiyyemo hammalve achar kach bevet din hare hu kishar hashshetarot:

Hotzi alav shetar mekuyyam veamar hallo mezuyyaf hu umeolam lo ketavtiv o shetar amana hu veamar hammalve ken haddevarim aval shetar kasher haya li veavad af al pi shehammalve hu sheshshavar et shetaro veillu ratza amar eno mezuyyaf shehare nitkayyem bevet din eno gove bo kelum ella nishba hallo hesset veniftar shehare ze hashshetar kecheres hu chashuv:
Shetar shellava bo uferao eno chozer velo bo shekkevar nimchal shibudo venaasa kecheres:

Hammotzi shetar chov mekuyyam al chavero veamar hallo halo peraticha veamar lo hammalve ken haya aval chazarti vehechzarti lecha hammaot vehilveti otcha paam sheniyya hare batel hashshetar shennifra vahare hu kecheres. aval im amar lo hechzarti lecha hammaot mippene shello hayu tovot ad shettachalifem lo batel hashshetar vaadayin shibudo kayyam:

Hotzi alav shetar mekuyyam sheyyesh lo alav mane veamar lo hallo halo peraoticha bifne peloni ufeloni uvau ellu veheidu shepperao aval lo hizkir lo et hashshetar veamar lo hammalve ken hu shepparata aval chov acher parata shehaya li etzlecha hare batel hashshetar. bamme devarim amurim kesheheidu shennatan lo betorat peraon aval im rauhu noten lo maot velo yadu im hu betorat peraon o betorat pikkadon o betorat mattana. im amar baal hashshetar lo hayu devarim meolam hare huchzak kafran uvatel hashshetar. veim amar peraon shel chov acher hu hare ze neeman venishba venotel ma shebbashshetar shehare lo perao beedim. mittoch sheyyachol lomar mattana netanam li neeman lomar peraon shel chov acher hen. amar lo hallo vahalo shetar chov ze deme shor shellakachti mimmecha hu veatta gavita deme besaro. veamar lo baal hashshetar ken ani gaviti et damav mechov acher shehaya li etzlecha. hoil vehoda meatzmo sheddeme hashshor hu hachov umiddamav nifra batel hashshetar. veaf al pi sheen alav edim sheppara middamav yishshava hallo hesset shepperao. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hotzi alav shetar chov beed echad velo toen parati hare ze mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava umeshallem. taan veamar yishshava li shello perativ hare ze nishba sheafillu hayu bashshetar shene edim veamar yishshava li shello perativ hare ze nishba kemo shebbearnu:

Vechen horu rabbotay shehakkofer bemilve al pe bevet din uva ed echad shellava hare ze yishshava shevuat hattora. chazar veamar ken haya laviti ufarati o machal li o nitchayyev li mimmakom acher hare ze mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava umeshallem:

Mi shettaan sheppara hashshetar veamar yishshava hammalve veyittol omrim lo have meotav veachar kach yishshava veyittol. im en lo kelum leshallem mashbiin oto ketakkanat haggeonim sheen lo velichshettassig yado yitten levaal chovo veyashbio shello para veachar kach yitten lo:

Mi shehaya lo chov al chavero bishtar veavad hashshetar vahare haedim kayyamin af al pi shekkanu miyyado vetaan sheppara hare ze nishba hesset. vehoru rabbotay sheafillu haya hachov lizman vaadayin lo higgia zemanno lehippara hoil vechatvu lo hashshetar veen beyado shetar vehallo toen parati neeman venishba hesset shepperao sheanu choshshin shemma perao ulefichach kara hashshetar o serafo. vechen horu rabbotay sheafillu haya hashshetar yotze mittachat yede acher vehallo toen mimmenni nafal achar shepparati af al pi shehu betoch zemanno nishba hesset veniftar shekkevan sheen hashshetar beyad hammalve en sham chazaka:

Shenayim shehen ochazin bishtar hammalve omer shelli hu vehotzetiv lehippara bo mimmecha vehallo omer perativ umimmenni nafal. im haya hashshetar sheyyachol lekayyemo ze yishshava sheen lo bedamim ellu pachot mechetzyan veze yishshava sheen lo baddamim pachot mechetzyan vishallem hallo mechetza. veim eno yachol lekayyemo yishshava hallo hesset shepperao veyelech lo:

Haomer lachavero mane yesh li beyadcha vehalla omer en lecha beyadi kelum o sheomer peraticha. amar lo hattovea hishshava li hesset. amar lo hannitba vahalo shetar yesh lecha alay veatta rotze lehashebia oti techilla veachar kach totzi hashshetar happarua vetigbe bo. omrim lo have hashshetar. amar hammalve en li shetar alav meolam o shetar haya li veavad horu rabbotay sheomrim lammalve battel kol shetar sheyyesh lecha kodem zeman ze veachar kach tashbiehu hesset o hacharem cherem setam velech uvakkesh ad shettimtza hashshetar:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 15:
Hammalve et chavero beedim veamar al tifraeni ella beedim ben sheamar lo bishat halevaa ben sheamar lo achar shehilvahu hare ze tzarich lefaro beedim mippene hattenay. taan hallo veamar lo vechen asiti uferaticha bifne peloni ufeloni vehalchu lahem limdinat hayyam o metu hare ze neeman venishba shevuat hesset veniftar. vechen im amar al tifraeni ella bifne talmide chachamim o bifne rofim veamar lo bifnehem peraticha veotan haedim shepperaticha bifnehem metu o halchu lahem limdinat hayyam hare ze neeman venishba hesset veniftar. aval im amar lo al tifraeni ella bifne peloni ufeloni veamar lo peraticha bifne acherim umetu o halchu lahem limdinat hayyam eno neeman shemmippene taana zo hitna alav veamar lo al tifraeni ella bifne reuven veshimon shehem omdim immo kede shello yidche oto veyomar bifne acherim parati vehalchu lahem: 
Yesh nuschaot min haggemara shekkatuv bahen shehaomer lachavero al tifraeni ella beedim veamar lo peraticha bifne peloni ufeloni vehalchu limdinat hayyam eno neeman vetaut sefarim hu ulefichach tau hammorim al pi otan hassefarim uchevar chakarti al hannuschaot hayeshanot umatzati bahen shehu neeman vehiggia leyadi bemitzrayim miktzat gemara yeshana katuv al haggevilim kemo shehayu kotvin kodem lazzeman hazze bekarov chamesh meot shana ushete nuschaot matzati min haggevilim bahalacha zo uvishtehem katuv veim amar parati bifne peloni ufeloni vehalchu lahen limdinat hayyam neeman. umippene taut zo sheera lemiktzat hassefarim horu miktzat geonim sheim amar lo al tifraeni ella bifne peloni ufeloni uferao bifne acherim sheeno neeman af al pi shehevi edim shepparu bifnehem vegam zo taut gedola vehaddin haemet sheim bau edim shepparu bifnehem niftar veen kan mekom chashash. gam hahoraa hazzot al pi sifrehen shekkatuv bahen beoto sheamar lachavero peraeni bifne edim sheshshanu halachot vehalach uferao bifne edim vetaut sefarim hu umatzati baggevilim katuv azal pareh beneh leven dileh af al pi shehassefarim muggahin kemo shebbearnu kach yerae middin haggemara. veod devarim shel daat hen vechi me haya lo laasot amar lo al tifraeni ella beedim perao beedim vechi yesh lo leesor et haedim bevet hassohar kol yemehem shello yelchu veod im metu ma yaase nimtza ze porea paam achar paam leolam ad sheyyavi edim im ken naaset edut zo edut bishtar venimtza ze kevan sheamar al tifraeni ella beedim naaset milve bishtar veen mi sheala al libbo ze. aval vadday im amar bifne peloni ufeloni hu hifsid al atzmo sheppara bifne acherim vehalchu lahem. aval im bau veheidu shepperao en kan bet mechosh vechaze rauy ladun ulehorot: 
Hitna hammalve al hallo sheyyihye neeman bechol et sheyyomar shello perao hare ze notel belo shevua af al pi shettaan shepperao. veim hevi edim shepperao eno notel kelum: 
Hitna alav sheyyihye hammalve neeman kishne edim af al pi shehevi edim shepperao hare ze gove mimmennu belo shevua shehare heemino kishne edim. vaafillu hevi mea edim (shepperao hare gove mimmennu belo shevua vaafillu hevi mea edim) shepperao bifnehem shehashshenayim kemea. aval im amar lo hare atta neeman alay kishlosha hoil veyarad leminyan im perao bifne arbaa hare ze parua. ze sheheemin hammalve kishne edim ma tihye takkanato kesheyyippara yikra hashshetar o yaid ze hammalve al atzmo shebbittel kol shetar sheyyesh lo al peloni. o yaid al atzmo shello bifne hallo shekkibbel kol chov sheyyesh lo etzel peloni: 
Hare shepperao vetaan hammalve shello nifra uferao paam sheniyya mippene hattenay hare hallo chozer vetovea et hammalve bedin veomer lo kach vechach atta chayyav li mippene shepperaticha shete peamim. im hoda yeshallem veim kafar yishshava shevuat hesset al kach shello perao ella paam achat. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hitna hallo sheyyihye neeman bechol et sheyyomar parati eno gove bishtar ze lo min hayyoresh velo min hallokeach. vaafillu amar lo lo parati en hammalve toref bishtar ze min hallakochot shemma asu kenuneya al nechasav shel ze. taan hallo bishtar ze veamar parati miktzato vehammalve omer lo para kelum meshallem hammiktzat shehoda bo venishba shevuat hesset shehare heemino. veim hitna alav sheyyihye neeman belo shevuat hesset eno nishba: 
Hitna hammalve sheyyihye gove belo shevua hare ze gove mimmennu belo shevua. aval im ba ligbot miyyorshav yishshava veachar kach yigbe. veim hitna sheyyigbe af min hayyoresh belo shevua gove belo shevua. vechen im hitna sheyyigbe min haidit gove min haidit af min hayyorshin. shekkol tenay shebbemamon kayyam. ba ligbot min hallokeach lo yitrof ella bishvua sheen ze matne leabbed mamon chavero:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 16:
Hachov beacharayut hallo ad sheyyifraennu leyd hammalve o leyad shelucho. amar lo hammalve zerok li chovi vehippater uzerako veavad o nisraf kodem sheyyaggia leyad hammalve patur. amar lo zerok li chovi betorat gittin. hayu hammaot kerovot lallo hare adayin beacharayuto. hayu kerovot lammalve niftar hallo. mechetza al mechetza im avdu mishsham o nignevu meshallem hallo mechetza: 
Haya reuven chayyav leshimon mane veamar lelevi holech leshimon mane ze sheani chayyav lo. im ba lachzor eno chozer vehu chayyav beacharayuto ad sheyyaggia hammane leshimon. hechzir levi et hammane liruven shenehen chayyavin beacharayuto ad sheyyaggia leyad shimon kol chovo: 
Reuven shehaya chayyav leshimon mane veamar shimon liruven mane sheyyesh li beyadcha tenehu lelevi vehayu shelashtan omdin vekibbel levi venimtza reuven ani veen lo mimma sheyyigbe mimmennu hare levi chozer bachov shel shimon shezze hitahu. veim yada levi shehu ani o shehaya ashir beotah shaa veheeni eno yachol lachzor shehare kibbel. taan levi shehaya reuven ani vehitahu veshimon omer ashir haya veheeni yerae li sheal shimon lehavi reaya veachar kach yippater mechov levi. lo yihye ella shover beyado. omrim lo kayyem shovercha vehippater: 
Kevar bearnu behilchot mikkach umimkar sheruven shello haya lo etzel shimon kelum vehaya reuven chayyav lelevi mane vehimchahu etzel shimon af al pi shehimchahu bemaamad shelashtan lo kana. veim ratza shimon shello yitten lo yitten veim natan chozer vegove meruven shehare al piv natan. vechen im ratza levi lachzor velomar eni rotze ligbot mishshimon chozer vegove meruven veaf al pi shennifra miktzat mishshimon chozer vegove hashshear meruven: 
Chenvani shehaya noten levaal habbayit min hachanut kol ma sheyyirtze betorat halevaa umakkifo ad sheyyitkabbetz hakkol uforea lo veamar lo baal habbayit ten lappoalim sela o levaal chovi mane sheyyesh lo etzli vaani etten lecha vahare hachenvani omer natatti vehappoel o baal chovo omer lo lakachti hare happoel o baal chov nishba venotel mibbaal habbayit chovo vechen hachenvani nishba venotel mibbaal habbayit ma shettaan shennatan shehare hu amar lo litten. vehappoel nishba bemaamad hachenvani vechen hachenvani bemaamad happoel o baal chov kede sheyyikkalmu ze mizze. vechen kol kayyotze baze. ushevua zo takkanat chachamim hi binkitat chefetz mippene shebbain shenehen littol. lefichach im met hachenvani notel baal chov belo shevua vechen im met poel o baal chov hachenvani notel belo shevua shehare en baal habbayit mafsid kelum veeno meshallem ella tashlum echad: 
Hachenvani omer atta amarta litten laze mane o tzivvita veamarta li im yavo peloni ten lo uvaal habbayit omer lo amarti lecha hare baal habbayit nishba hesset veniftar vehachenvani ose din im ze shennatan lo. vechen im amar hachenvani levaal habbayit hammakkifo katuv befinkasi sheyyesh li etzlecha mane uvaal habbayit omer eni yodea nishba baal habbayit hesset sheeno yodea veniftar kedin kol toen al chavero lechol davar veen baze takkanat chachamim: 
Reuven shehotzi shetar chov sheyyesh lelevi al shimon vetaan shellevi netano lo bichtiva umesira veavad hashshetar shehiknahu bo o shettaan shehiknahu lo al gav hakkarka hare ze gove oto mishshimon hoil veyotze mittachat yado. taan shimon sheppara lelevi veamar yishshava li yishshava levi leshimon veachar kach yigbe reuven. hoda lo sheppara yeshallem levi liruven. taan levi shello machar velo natan shetar ze nishba hesset veniftar: 
Shetar shehaya beyad shalish vehotzi mittachat yado bevet din veamar parua hu neeman af al pi shehashshetar mekuyyam sheillu ratza haya sorfo o koro. vechen im met hashshalish venimtza ketav yotze mittachat yede shalish sheshshetar ze hammunnach etzlo parua hu hare ze parua af al pi sheen edim al hakketav. aval ketav sheyyatza mittachat yede malve sheshshetar peloni parua afillu haya bichtav yede hammalve eno ella kemischak: 
Hayu edim al hakketav im hayu mekuyyamin hare hashshetar parua. veim en alav kiyyum yishalu haedim hachatumin al ze hashshover. im lo yadu o sheen haedim metzuyin hoil umittachat yede hammalve o mittachat yede yorshav yatza en hashshover kelum: 
Nimtza hashshetar ben shetarot peruin hare ze parua veaf al pi sheen edim al hakketav hannimtza. vechen im nimtza katuv begufo shel shetar ben mippanav ben meachorav vaafillu bemiktzato shetar ze parua o nifra mimmennu kach vechach osin al pi hakketav veaf al pi sheen al hakketav edim veaf al pi sheyyatza mittachat yede hammalve sheillu lo nifra lo haya kotev al hashshetar: 
Hammotze shetar ben shitrotav veen yodea ma tivo yihye munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu: 
Haomer levanav shetar ben shitrotay parua veeni yodea eze hu shitrotav kullan peruin. nimtza leechad sham shene shetarot haggadol parua vehakkatan eno parua. amar lachavero shetar lecha beyadi parua haggadol parua vehakkatan eno parua. chov lecha beyadi parua kol shetarot sheyyesh lo alav kullan peruin:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 17: Malve shemmet uva hyyoresh litboa et hallo bishtar shealav veamar parati leavicha vehayyoresh omer eni yodea omrim lo amod veshallem lo. amar yishshava li hare ze nishba binkitat chefetz shello pekadanu abba al yede acher veshello amar lanu abba befiv veshello matzinu ben shitrotav shel abba sheshshetar ze parua vegove:

Met hallo achar shemmet hammalve uva hayyoresh lehippara min hayyoresh lo yippara ella bishvua veomer lo techilla yishshava shello pekadanu abba veshello amar lanu abba velo matzinu ben shitrotav shel abba sheshshetar ze parua. vaafillu haya hayyoresh katan hammuttal baarisa keshemmet morisho hare ze nishba venotel. veim tzivva hammalve bishat mitato sheshshetar ze eno parua yippara hayyoresh belo shevua afillu min hayyoresh:

Met hallo techilla veachar kach met hammalve en yorshe malve notlin miyyorshe lo kelum shebbeshaa shemmet hallo nitchayyev hammalve lehishshava veachar kach yittol kemo shebbearnu uchevar met veen adam morish shevua levanav sheenan yecholin lehishshava shello nifra avihem kelum. veim avar haddayyan vehishbia yorshe malve vegavu et chovan en motziin miyyadam. lefichach shetar chov shel yetomim habbaim lehippara min hayetomim shemmet avihen hallo techilla en korin oto veen magbin bo. en govin bo sheen adam morish shevua levanav kemo shebbearnu veen korin oto shemma yavo dayyan sheyyadun veyotzi bo:
Afillu haya sham arev umet hallo techilla lo yipparu yorshe hammalve min hearev. sheim tomar yipparu min hearev hare hearev chozer venifra miyyorshe lo:

En danin middin ze lechol haddome lo ella hare happogem et shetaro umet af al pi sheeno gove ella bishvua hare banav nishbain shello pekadanu abba velo tzivvanu abba velo matzinu ben shitrotav shel abba shekkol hashshetar hazze parua vegovin et shear hashshetar ben min hammalve ben miyyorshav:

Yoresh shebba ligbot min hayyoresh veamru yorshe lo amar lanu abba lo laviti chov ze hare yorshe hammalve govin shello bishvua shekkol haomer lo laviti keomer lo parati dami. vechen malve shebba lehippara miyyorshe lo veamru amar lanu abba lo laviti chov ze hare ze govehu belo shevua afillu heemino bashshetar kol zeman sheamar parati shekkol haomer lo laviti keomer lo parati:

Yoresh shebba lehippara min hallo bishtar sheyyesh bo neemanut lallo kol zeman sheyyomar parati hare hallo nishba hesset sheppara lishtar ze veniftar af al pi shello katav lo vahare atta neeman al yorshay sheikkar hashshetar al tenay ze haya. im hitna alav sheyyehe neeman belo shum shevua eno nishba afillu leyorshe malve:

Yoresh katan shehaya shetar chov leaviv veyatza alav shover achar mitat aviv en korin et hashshetar veen magbin bo ad sheyyigdelu hayetomim shemma shover ze mezuyyaf hu ulefichach lo hotzio hallo bechayye aviv:

Hammotzi shetar chov al chavero vehaya katuv bevavel magbehu mimmeot bavel. haya katuv beeretz yisrael magbehu mimmeot eretz yisrael. ma sheen ken bichtubba. lo haya bashshetar shem makom vehotzio bevavel magbehu mimmeot bavel. hotzio beeretz yisrael magbehu mimmeot eretz yisrael. ba ligbot mimmeot hammakom sheyyatza bo hashshetar vetaan hallo shehammaot sheani chayyav lo mikkesef shehu pachot mizze hammatbea yishshava hammalve veyittol. haya bo kesef setam ma sheyyirtze lo magbehu. mikkan atta lamed sheshshetar sheen bo shem makom shennichtav bo kasher lechol davar. vehu haddin lishtar sheen bo zeman kelal shehu kasher af al pi sheedut zo i atta yachol lahazimmah sheen medakdekin bedine mamonot bidrisha vachakira kemo sheyyitbaer kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin. ulefichach shitre chov hameucharin kesherin af al pi sheen atta yachol lahazimman kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 18:
Hammalve et chavero setam hare kol nechasav achrain vearvain lechov ze. lefichach kesheyyavo ligbot tovea et baal chovo techilla im matza immo nechasim ben mittaltelin ben karkaot gove mehen birtzon hallo. veim lo natan hallo middato megabbin oto bet din. lo hispik lo kol hannimtza keneged shetar chovo hare ze gove mikkol hakkarkaot shehayu lallo af al pi shehen atta mechurin laacherim o netunim bemattana. hoil umachar hallo o natan achar shennishtabed bechov ze hare ze motzi miyyad hallakochot o miyyad baale hammattanot vezehu hannikra toref. bamme devarim amurim bekarkaot shehayu lo beet shellava. aval nechasim habbain lo leachar shellava lo nishtabedu levaal chov veeno torfan. veim hitna alav shekkol nechasim sheyyikne yihyu meshubadin lehippara mehen vekana achar shellava umachar o natan hare baal chov toref mehen: 
En kol haddevarim amurin ella bekarka aval hammittaltelin en alehen acharayut afillu mittaltelin shehayu lo beet shellava shemmecharan lishato en baal chov toref otan. hikna levaal chovo kol hammittaltelin al gav karka sheyyesh lo lihyoto nifra min hakkol hare ze toref meotan hammittaltelin vehu sheyyichtov lo bishtar chovo shehikneti lecha mittaltelin sheyyesh li al gav hakkarka sheyyesh li shello keasmachta veshello ketafse hashshetarot. vechen im katav shekkol nechasim sheani atid liknot ben karkaot ben mittaltelin hare hen meshubadim lecha lehippara mehen vehammittaltelin kenuyin lecha al gav hakkarkaot lehippara mehen shello keasmachta veshello ketafse hashshetarot hare ze toref af min hammittaltelin shekkana hallo leachar shellava. shekkol tenay shebbemamon kayyam: 
Asa sadehu appoteke levaal chovo o leishsha bichtubbatah vehu sheyyichtov lahen mikkan tigbu ushetafo nahar hare ze gove mishshear nechasim vetoref otan. veim hitna immo shello yihye lo peraon ella mizzo eno gove mishshear nechasim. vechen im lava mimmennu uferesh sheen lo acharayut alav hare ze eno gove min hameshubadin leolam: 
Asa sadehu appoteki levaal chovo o leishsha bichtubbatah umecharah hare zo mechura uchesheyyavo baal chov ligbot im lo yimtza nechasim bene chorin yitrof otah. bamme devarim amurim beshemmachar lishatah aval mecharah mimkar olam enah mechura: 
Asa avdo appoteke umecharo hare baal chov gove mimmennu mippene sheyyesh lo kol. asa shoro appoteke umecharo en baal chov gove mimmennu. vechen shear hammittaltelin mippene sheen lahen kol: 
Eved sheasaahu rabbo appoteke veshichrero af al pi shekkatav lo lo yihye lecha peraon ella mizze yetze lecherut. vechen im hikdisho. shehechametz vehashshichrur vehahekdesh mafkiin miyyad shibud vahare baal chov gove chovo min hallo vechotev alav shetar bechovo vetoref mizzeman ze hashshetar. velamma hu chayyav leshallem mippene sheggorem leabbed mamon chavero vechol haggorem lehazzik meshallem kemo shebbearnu bimkomo. vechofin et rabbo hashsheni leshachrero mippene tikkun haolam shello yimtzaennu bashshuk veyomar lo avdi atta: 
Hammakdish nechasav en baal chov yachol litrof min hahekdesh shehahekdesh mafkia hashshibud. uchesheppodin hakkarka miyyad hahekdesh omdin kamma adam rotze litten besade zo al menat sheyyitten levaal chov et chovo uleishsha ketubbatah. lefichach lichshettippade vetetze lechullin beyad hallokeach yavo baal chov veyitrof otah o haishsha bichtubbatah kemo shebbearnu baarachin: 
Baal chov shebba litrof im yesh maot lallokeach yachol lesalleko velitten lo deme ma shehu toref vechozer hallokeach vetovea lammocher. veim asa oto appoteke eno yachol lesalleko bedamim: 
Reuven shehaya chayyav leshimon matayim vehayu lo shete sadot umachar achat mehen lelevi bemane vechazar umachar lo hashsheniyya bemane uva shimon vetaraf achat bemane vechazar litrof hashsheniyya bammane hannishar lo vehevi lo matayim veamar lo im tirtze lihyot hassade shettarafta shuma lecha bechol hammatayim sheyyesh lecha hare mutav veim lav helach matayim shel chovcha vehistallek. haddin im levi. ratza shimon veamad bah af al pi shekkibbelah bematayim en levi chozer vetovea reuven ella bemane: 
Met reuven vehinniach sade achat shava mea uva shimon uterafah venatnu lo hayetomim mea min hammittaltelin shehinniach avihen vesillekuhu hare ze chozer vetoref otah bishar chovo. shemmea shennatnu lo mitzva asu shemmitzva al hayetomim lifroa chovot avihem. veim amru lo ellu bemea deme hassade shettarafta eno yachol lachzor velitrof otah paam acheret bishar chovo:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 19:
Kesheyyordin bet din lenichse hallo ligbot mehen lo yigbu levaal chov ella min habbenonit shebbekarkeotav. vedin tora sheyyigbe baal chov min hazzibburit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 11)</small> "bachutz taamod vehaish asher atta noshe vo yotzi" vegomer ma darko shel adam lehotzi pachut shebbechelav. aval tikkenu chachamim bevenoniyyt kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin. bamme devarim amurim beva lippara min hallo atzmo. aval habba lippara min hayyorshin ben ketannim ben gedolim lo yippara ella min hazzibburit: 
En nifraim minnechasim meshubadin bemakom sheyyesh nechasim bene chorin vaafillu hayu bene chorin zibburit vehameshubadim benonit o idit ben shemmecharam ben shennetanam. nishtaddefu bene chorin hare ze toref min hameshubadin shekkevan shennishchatu keillu enam: 
Reuven shemmachar kol sedotav leshimon vechazar shimon umachar sade achat mehen lelevi uva baal chov shel reuven litrof ratza mizze gove ratza mizze gove. bamme devarim amurim keshellakach levi benonit. aval im lakach idit o zibburit eno toref millevi shehare ze omer lo mippene ze tarachti velakachti sade sheen dincha ligbot mimmennu. vechen im lakach levi benonit vehinniach etzel shimon benonit kemo habbenonit shellakach eno toref millevi shehare ze omer lo hinnachti lecha makom ligbot mimmennu: 
Kevar bearnu shehannizzakin shamin lahen beidit uvaal chov bevenonit uchetubbat ishsha bezibburit. hayu lo idit vezibburit nizzakin beidit baal chov [uchetubbat ishsha] bezibburit. hayu lo idit uvenonit nizzakin beidit uvaal chov uchetubbat ishsha bevenonit. hayu lo zibburit uvenonit bilvad nizzakin uvaal chov bevenonit uchetubbat ishsha bezibburit: 
Mecharan lishlosha bene adam bevat achat hare kullan nichnesu tachat habbealim vehannizzakin torfin min haidit uvaal chov toref min habbenonit uchetubbat ishsha torefet min hazzibburit. mecharan laze achar ze kullan torfin min haacharon. lo hispik torfin mishshellefanav. lo hispik torfin mishshellifne fanav. afillu haya haacharon hu shellakach hazzibburit shehare hallokeach hakkodem omer lattoref hinnachti lecha makom ligbot mimmennu: 
Mecharan leechad zo achar zo hare hallokeach nichnas tachat habbealim. bamme devarim amurim shellakach idit baacharona aval lakach zibburit baacharona kullan govin min hazzibburit shehare omer lattoref kesheyyavo ligbot min hassade shellakach techilla hare hinnachti lecha makom ligbot mimmennu. velamma eno omer lo hattoref kach im lakach idit baacharona vetigbe haishsha uvaal chov min haidit shellakach baacharona. shezzo takkana hi lallokeach vahare omer lokeach lahen i efshi betakkana zo ella kol echad mikkem yigbe min harauy lo: 
Mecharan leechad zo achar zo umachar lo idit baacharona vechazar hallokeach umachar zibburit uvenonit veshiyyer idit lefanav kullan govin min haidit shehare en lo bema yidche otam. machar idit vehinniach benonit vezibburit hannizzakin torfin min haidit shebbeyad lokeach hashsheni uvaal chov uchetubbat ishsha govin mibbenonit vezibburit sheshshiyyer lefanav: 
Mi shellava meechad veachar kach machar hallo nechasav lishnayim vechatav baal chov lelokeach sheni din udevarim en li immecha vekanu miyyado eno yachol litrof millokeach rishon shehare omer lo hinnachti lecha makom ligbot mimmennu etzel baal chovcha min hannechasim shekkana lokeach sheni acharay veatta hifsadta al atzmecha shehare sillakta atzmecha mehen. vehu haddin leishsha bichtubbatah im katva lashsheni. ibbeda ketubbatah veenah yechola litrof. aval im katvu larishon torfin min hashsheni. machar hallo sade lallokeach umecharah lokeach rishon lelokeach sheni vechatav hammalve lelokeach rishon din udevarim en li immecha vekanu miyyado hare baal chov toref millokeach sheni otah hassade velokeach rishon toref otah mibbaal chov shehare katav lo velokeach sheni toref otah millokeach rishon shehare hu mecharah lo uvaal chov chozer vetoref mishsheni vechozrin chalila ad sheyyaasu peshara benehen. vechen haishsha bichtubbatah:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 20:
Mi sheyyesh lo chovot harebe kol shekkadam chovo gove techilla ben min hallo atzmo ben min hallakochot. veim kadam haacharon vegava motziim miyyado shekkol shekkadam chovo zacha. bamme devarim amurim bekarkaot shehayu lo beet shellava aval hakkarkaot shekkana achar shellava mibbaale chovot harebe af al pi shekkatav lechol echad mehen ma sheani atid liknot meshubad lecha en bahen din kedima ella kullan shavin vechol shekkadam vegava zacha af al pi shehu acharon: 
Lava vechatav lo sheani atid liknot meshubad lecha veachar kach kana sade vechazar velava meacher hare hassade meshubad larishon vehu kodem ligbot. vechen afillu hayu mea en din kedima bemittaltelin ella kol shekkadam vegava mehen zacha af al pi shehu acharon. kiddem echad mishshear adam vetafas min hammittaltelin shel ze kede lizkot leechad mibbaale chovot lo zacha shekkol hattofes levaal chov bemakom sheyyesh alav chov laacherim lo kana. aval en alav chov laacherim kana lo. vechen im amar lo hallo zeche bechefetz ze lifloni zacha lo veen echad mibbaale chovot yecholin ligbot meellu hammittaltelin shekkevar zacha bahen acher: 
Shetarot shezzeman kullan yom echad o shaa achat bemakom shekkotvin shaot kol shekkadam mehen vegava ben karka ben mittaltelin zacha: 
Bau kullan beyachad ligbot. vechen baale chovot shekkol echad mehen kodem lizman chavero shebbau ligbot min hammittaltelin shehare en bahen din kedima. o shebbau ligbot mikkarka shekkana hallo leachar shellava min haacharon shebbahen veen bannechasim kede sheyyigbe kol echad mehen et chovo. mechallekin benehen. ketzad cholkin. im kesheyyitchallek hammamon hannimtza al minyanam yaggia lappachut shebbahen keshiur chovo o pachot cholkim lefi minyanam beshave. veim yaggia lappachut shebbahem yoter al chovo cholkim mikkol hammamon benehem kede sheyyaggia lappachut shebbahem keshiur chovo vechozrin hannisharim mibbaale chovot vecholkin hayyeter benehen kadderech hazzot. ketzad. hayu shelosha chovot shel ze mane veshel ze matayim veshel ze shelosh meot im haya kol hannimtza shelosh meot notlin mea mea. vechen im nimtza sham pachot mishshelosh meot cholkin beshave. nimtza sham yeter al shelosh meot cholkin shelosh meot beshave veyistallek baal hammea ushear hammamon cholkin oto hashshenayim al otah hadderech. ketzad. nimtzeu sham chamesh meot o pachot cholkin shelosh meot beshave veyistallek haechad vechozrin vecholkin hammatayim o happachot beshave veyistallek hashsheni. nimtza sham shesh meot cholkin shelosh meot beshave veyistallek baal hammane vechozrin vecholkin hammatayim ben hashshenayim beshave veyistallek baal hammatayim. venotnin hammea hannisharim levaal hashshelosh meot venimtza beyado shelosh meot bilvad. veal derech zo cholkin afillu hen mea kesheyyavou ligbot keachat. veyesh min haggeonim shehoru shecholkin lefi mamonam: 
Reuven veshimon lechol echad mishshenehem shetar chov al levi reuven shetaro bachamishi benisan veshimon shetaro benisan setam vahare yesh lelevi sade sheenah kede chov shel shenehem moridin letochah reuven shemma shetaro shel shimon besof nisan haya. vechen en shimon yachol litrof meiyyar veelach shehare hallokeach omer lo shemma beechad benisan hu zemanno shel shetarcha vahare sade bat chorin beyad reuven shettigbe otah veyavo reuven shehu achar zemannecha vehu sheyyesh lo litrof mimmennu. lefichach im katvu hareshaa ze laze torfin meiyyar veelach mikkol tzad. vehu haddin biruven veshimon shemmachar lahen levi sade achat bishne shetarot shetaro shel ze bachamishsha benisan ushetaro shel ze benisan setam:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 21: Baal chov gove et hashshevach shehishbiach hallokeach ben shehishbichu mechamat hotzaa ben sheshshavchu nechasim mealehen. ella sheim shavchu mealehen toref kol hashshevach veim hishbichu mechamat hotzaa gove chatzi hashshevach. ketzad. reuven shehaya lo chov al shimon matayim umachar shimon lelevi sade bemane vehotzi aleha levi hotzaot vehishbichah vahare hi shava matayim. kesheyyavo reuven litrof millevi toref mimmenna bemea vachamishshim shel chatzi hashshevach. veim hishbicha mechamat atzmah kegon shehukera bedamim o alu bah ilanot gove et kullah. horu chachamim gedolim veamru lo yehe hallokeach ra kocho mehayyored lisde chavero shello birshut sheshshamin lo veyado al hattachtona lefichach im hishbiach mea vehotzi chamishshim notel kol hahotzaa vachatzi hashshevach hayyater al hahotzaa vehachatzi im hakkeren toref baal chov [udevarim shel taam hem vechach rauy ladun] vechozer hallokeach vegove et hakkeren minnichse shimon af min hameshubadin shemmachar o natan meachar zeman shemmachar bo lelevi. aval hashshevach shettaraf mimmennu baal chov ben bechetzyo ben bechullo en levi govehu ella minnechasim bene chorin shel shimon shettakkanat olam hi shello yigbe hashshevach velo happerot sheachal haggazlan velo mezon haishsha vehabbanot minnechasim meshubadin sheellu devarim sheen lahen kitzva. umikkulle ketubba shello titrof ishsha min hashshevach ketubbatah. velamma yitrof baal chov chatzi hashshevach bilvad habbaa mechamat hotzaa atzmah lefi shehashshevach ba leachar shellava meruven uleachar shemmachar lelevi venimtza reuven velevi kishne baale chovot leshimon vehashshevach bannechasim shebbau lo achar shellava mishshenehem shehen cholkin keechad kemo shebbearnu. lefichach reuven shellava mishshimon mane vechatav lo sheani atid liknot vechazar velava millevi matayim vechatav lo sheani atid liknot vekana achar kach sade umecharah lihuda bemea vachamishshim vehishbichah yehuda behotzaato vahare hi shava shelosh meot toref shimon velevi hakkeren vecholkin oto beshave venimtza beyad ze chamishsha veshivim uveyad ze chamishsha veshivim. vechozrin shimon velevi vihuda shelashtan vecholkin mea vachamishshim shel shevach al hadderech shepperashnu. nimtza shimon toref mane shello missade zo velevi toref mea usheloshim veshiva umechetza vihuda notel min hashshevach shenayim veshishshim umechetza. vechaze hen cholkin afillu hen mea:

Kol happerot sheachal hallokeach enan nitrafin mimmennu. aval happerot hamechubbarin lakkarka af al pi sheenan tzerichin lakkarka kaanavim shehiggiu lehibbatzer hare baal chov gove mehen kemo sheggove min hashshevach:

Mattana sheshshavcha mechamat hotzaa en baal chov gove mishshivchah kelum ella roin kamma hayta shava bishat mattana vegove. veim shavcha meeleha baal chov gove et kullah. veim kibbel hannoten acharayut hammattana hare baal chov gove mimmenna et hashshevach kederech sheggovin min hallakochot. velamma yitrof baal chov chatzi hashshevach min hallokeach velo yitrof mimmekabbel mattana kelum. mippene shehammocher kotev lallokeach bishtar mechira sheani mechuyyav lecha bakkeren uveamal shettaamol uvashshevach shettashbiach vealay acharayut hakkol veratza hallokeach vekibbel davar ze shehare hallokeach yarad al tenay ze sheim yillakach mimmennu hashshevach yachzor al hammocher. vaafillu lo katav kevar noda shezze din hammocher im hallokeach. aval hammatne sheen sham tenay ze eno gove mishshevach shehishbichah behotzaato kelum:
Vechen yetomim shehishbichu hannechasim en baal chov gove min hashshevach kelum. aval im shavchu nechasim mealehen gove et hashshevach kullo:

Baal chov shettaraf bechovo miyyad hallokeach ma sherauy lo min hakkeren vachatzi hashshevach roin hannishar min hakkarka im yesh bo teala lallokeach kegon shennishar lo bassade bayit tisha kabbin uvagginna bayit chatzi kav yishtattefu bah shenehem. veim lo nishar lo davar sheillu yechallek yihye shem kullo alav noten lo baal chov et damav:

Hayta hassade appoteke baal chov notel et kullah veroin chatzi hashshevach hannishar lallokeach im haya chatzi hashshevach yeter al hahotzaa notel hahotzaa mibbaal chov shehare omer lo baal chov sadi hu shehishbicha vehannishar lo min hashshevach notel min hammocher veim haya chatzi hashshevach pachot min hahotzaa en lo min hattoref ella deme chatzi hashshevach vechozer vegove min hammocher chatzi hashshevach shennitraf bilvad:

Baal chov shebba litrof min hayetomin. yetomim omrim anu hishbachnu uvaal chov omer shemma avichem hishbiach. al hayetomim lehavi reaya. heviu reaya shehem hishbichu shamin lahen et hashshevach veet hahotzaa venotlin happachut shebbishnehen umaale otan bedamim. bamme devarim amurim besheasa sade zo appoteke. aval im lo asahu appoteke im ratzu hayetomin lesallek baal chov bedamim mesallekin oto veim ratzu notlin min hakkarka shiur shevach shellahen:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 22:
Seder geviyyat hachov kach hu. kesheyyavi hammalve shetaro levet din veyitkayyem omrim lallo shallem. veen yordin linchasav techilla ad sheyyitbaennu. veim taa haddayyan vehorid hammalve lenichse lo kodem sheyyitbaennu mesallekin oto. amar hallo hareni meshallem kivu li zeman kede sheelve meacher o amashken o emkor veavi hammaot kovin lo zeman sheloshim yom veen mechayyevin oto litten mashkon sheillu hayu sham mittaltelim miyyad hayu bet din govin mehen. veim ratza hammalve lehacharim al mi sheyyesh lo maot o mittaltelin umaflig oto bidvarim hare ze macharim. veen mechayyevin hallo lehavi arev ad sheyyitten. shalmu hashsheloshim velo hevi bet din kotvin adrachta. vechen im amar battechilla keshettevao eni meshallem kotvin adrachta al nechasav miyyad veen kovin lo zeman. vechen im en sham ella milve al pe o shehoda kotvin adrachta al nichse bene chorin sheyyesh lo: 
Taan veamar shetar ze shennitkayyem bifnehem mezuyyaf hu ani avi reaya vaavattelennu veeday bemakom peloni vehem peloni ufeloni. im nire laddayyanin sheyyesh mammash bidvarav kovin lo zeman lehavi edav veim nire lahem sheeno ba ella baalilot devarim uvitanot shel dofi omrim lo shallem veachar kach im yesh lo reaya yachzor. veim haya hammalve allam veshemma eno yachol lehotzio miyyado mannichin al yede shalish: 
Kavu lo zeman lehavi reaya ulevattel hashshetar vehiggia hazzeman velo ba mamtinin lo sheni vachamishi vesheni. lo ba kotvin alav peticha umeshammetin oto umamtinin lo vehu benidduyo tishim yom. sheloshim rishonim shemma toreach lilvot. emtzaim shemma hu toreach limkor. acharonim shemma hallokeach mimmennu toreach lehavi maot. shalmu tishim yom velo ba bet din kotvin lo adrachta al nechasav umattirin lo nidduyo: 
En kotvin adrachta ad sheshsholchin umodiin lo. vehu sheyyihye karov bevet din mahalach shene yamim o pachot. yeter al ze en tzerichin lehodio. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya kol hattishim yom nishmat veomer atta avi reaya vaavattel hashshetar. aval amar eni ba levet din miyyad kotvin adrachta al nechasav ben al hakkarkaot ben al hammittaltelin. vechen im haya hashshetar al happikkadon en mamtinin lo tishim yom ella kotvin adrachta al nechasav miyyad: 
Ze sheamarnu sheim lo ba besof hattishim kotvin adrachta al hakkarkaot. aval al hammittaltelin afillu achar tishim yom kol zeman shehu omer atta avi reaya vaavattel hashshetar en moridin hammalve lammittaltelin shemma yochal otam veyavi ze reaya vivattel hashshetar velo yimtza ma yittol. vaafillu haya lammalve karka shemma tachsif o tishtaddef: 
Ketzad kotvin haadrachta. im linchasim bene chorin horiduhu omrim ish peloni nitchayyev lifloni baddin kach vechach velo natan lo meatzmo vechatavnu lo adrachta zo al sade pelonit shello. veachar kach shamin lo shelosha meotah sade keneged chovo umachrizin aleha kefi ma sheyyiru ad sheyyifseku hammosifin. umoridin oto bechovo lachelek sheshshamu oto vekorin shetar hachov im haya sham shetar. veim lo hayu lo nechasim bene chorin kotvin haadrachta kach ish peloni nitchayyev lifloni kach bishtar chov sheyyesh beyado velo natan lo chovo velo matzanu lo nechasim bene chorin. uchevar karanu lashshetar shehaya lo alav venatannu lifloni reshut lidrosh velachkor velihyot yado netuya al kol hannechasim sheyyimatzu lo vechol karkaot shemmachar mizzeman peloni vahala yesh lo lehippara ligbot chovo min hakkol: 
Veachar shekkotvin adrachta zo holech hammalve umechappes. im matza lo nechasim bene chorin shamin lo mehen. matza lo nechasim meshubadin meachar zeman shetaro toref mehen vekorin shetar haadrachta vechotvin lo shetar hattirfa: 
Ketzad kotvin. ish peloni ben peloni zacha baddin litrof bechov sheppeloni chayyav lo shehu kach vechach missade pelonit shellakach peloni bechach vechach mizzeman peloni. uchevar karanu haadrachta shehayta beyado vehirshinuhu litrof mizze bechach vechach: 
Veachar shekkotvin hattirfa litrof moridin shelosha bekiin leotah sade veshamin lo mimmenna keshiur chovo kefi ma sherauy lo min hakkeren vachatzi hashshevach kemo shebbearnu. umachrizin aleha sheloshim yom kederech shemmachrizin al nichse yetomim: 
Veachar kach mashbiin et hallo sheen lo kelum ketakkanat haggeonim im haya hallo immanu bammedina. umashbiin et hattoref binkitat chefetz shello nifra chov ze velo mechalo velo mecharo leacher. veachar kach moridin oto lenichse hallokeach beshuma shello vechotvin horada: 
Vechetzad kotvin. achar sheshshamnu lifloni beshuma shehayta beyado vehichraznu sheloshim yom karauy vehishbanu et ze hattoref veet baal chov horadnuhu lesade pelonit lihyot mishtammesh bah kederech shemmishtammesh adam bekinyano: 
Umeematay ochel hattoref perot sade zo mishsheyyifseku yeme hahachraza: 
Kol adrachta sheen katuv bah keranuhu lishtar hahalvaa enah adrachta. vechol tirfa sheen katuv bah keranuha laadrachta enah tirfa. vechol shuma dela katuv bah keranuha lattirfa enah shuma: 
Shelosha sheyyardu lashum. echad omer bemane ushenayim omrim bematayim o echad omer bematayim ushenayim omrim bemane. batel yachid bemiuto. echad omer bemane veechad omer bishmonim veechad omer bemea veesrim niddon bemea. echad omer bemea veechad omer tishim veechad omer mea usheloshim niddon bemea vaasara. veal derech zo shamin benehen: 
Bet din sheshshamu lattoref benichse lokeach vetau bechol shehu michran batel shehare hen keshaliach lattoref velallokeach veyesh lahen reshut letakken aval lo leavvet keshaliach. vechol hammorim kaze horu: 
Bet din sheshshamu levaal chov ben benichse lo ben bimshubadin shebbeyad hallokeach uleachar zeman hissiga yado shel lo o shel nitraf o shel yorshehen veheviu levaal chov et meotav mesallekin oto meotah karka. shehashshuma chozeret labbealim leolam. mishshum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 18)</small> "veasita hayyashar vehattov": 
Karka sheshshamu otah levaal chov veachar kach shamuha bet din levaal chov shel ze hammalve hare zo chozeret. lo yehe kocho gadol mikkoach baal chov harishon. mecharah baal chov o netanah bemattana o sheshshamah levaal chov middato o shemmet vehorishah enah chozeret. shamu karka leishsha venisset o sheshshamu mimmenna venisset baal benichse ishto kelokeach hu velo machzir velo machazirin lo:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 23:
Shitre chov hammukdamim pesulin shehare toref bahen lakochot shello kaddin ulefichach kansu oto chachamim velo yigbe bishtar mukdam ella mibbene chorin gezera shemma yitrof bo mizzeman rishon shehikdimo: 
Shitre chov hameucharin kesherin shehare hura kocho shel baal hashshetar sheeno toref ella mizzeman hashshetar. veaf al pi shello katvu bo shehu meuchar hare ze kasher: 
Shetar shekketavuhu bayyom venechtam ballayla hassamuch lo pasul mippene shehu mukdam. veim hayu asukim bainyan ad shennichnas hallayla vachatamuhu af al pi shekkanu mimmennu ballayla kasher: 
Shetar shezzemanno katuv beshabbat o baasara betishre shetar meuchar hu vechasher. veen choshshin shemma mukdam hu uveechad beshabbat o bey betishre nichtav ella maamidin hashshetar al chezkato shehaddavar yadua hu sheen kotvin beshabbat ulefichach icharuhu: 
Kotvin shetar lallo af al pi sheen hammalve immo veen kotvin lammalve ad sheyyihye lo immo. bamme devarim amurim bishtar sheyyesh bo kinyan shehare mishshaa shekkanu miyyado nishtabedu nechasav. aval shetar sheen bo kinyan en kotvin afillu lallo ad sheyyihye malve immo veyitten hashshetar beyad hammalve befanenu shemma yichtov atta lilvot mimmennu benisan velo yilve mimmennu ad tishre venimtza hammalve toref bishtar ze minnisan shello kaddin shello higgia leyado ad tishre: 
Edim shekkanu miyyad hallo o hammocher vechayyotze bahen venitachara ketivat hashshetar zeman merubbe im yadu yom shekkanu mimmennu bo kotvin bashshetar zeman hakkinyan veaf al pi sheeno zeman chatimatan. veen tzerichin lomar venitachara ketivat yadenu ad yom peloni. veim lo yadu yom shekkanu bo kotvin zemanno shel shetar mishsheat ketiva. vechen mi shennimsera lahen haedut bimdina achat vechatvu haedim bimdina acheret en mazkirin bashshetar makom shennimsera bo haedut ella makom shekkatvu bo chatimat yadan: 
Shitre mikkach umimkar shello nichtevu bizmannan afillu hameucharin pesulin shehare efshar litrof bahen shello kaddin. ketzad. kegon shechazar hammocher vekana hassade miyyad hallokeach kodem sheyyaggia zeman hashshetar hameuchar veyotzi halla hashshetar hameuchar veyomar chazarti ulekachtiha paam sheniyya mimmecha venimtza toref shello kaddin. velamma lo nachush ken lishtar chov hameuchar shemma yifraennu kodem sheyyaggia zemanno veyichtov shover veyachzor veyotzi hashshetar hameuchar veyitrof bo shello kaddin. lefi shekkol hakkotev shetar meuchar takkanato sheyyichtov hashshover setam shekkol zeman sheyyetze hashshetar yishbor oto ze hashshover. veim lo asa chen vechatav hashshover bizman happeraon hu hifsid al atzmo: 
Mi shemmachar sadehu beones umasar modaa. o shekkadam umachar o natan leacher kodem sheyyimkor leannas. hare hammaot shel annas etzel hammocher kemilve al pe veeno toref bishtar mecher shebbeyado kelum mippene sheen din shetar ze sheyyichtov velo nichtav ella mippene haones. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Efshar lattoref sheyyitrof belo shetar ella beedut al pe. ketzad. kegon sheyyesh lo edut shezzo gezula meaviv hare yesh lo lehotzi beedim ellu veen kan shetar. vechen im heidu lo shennigmar haddin leaviv litrof minnichse peloni bechach vechach mizzeman peloni umet aviv vaadayin lo taraf hare habben toref beedut zo: 
Lefichach en kotvin shene shitrot mecher al sade achat shemma yaase hallokeach kenuneya im baal chov veyitrof shello kaddin. ketzad. yavo ze veyitrof sade zo beedut sheheidu lo mechamat aviv veyachzor hallokeach veyitrof bishtar hammecher shebbeyado min hallakochot shellakchu acharav veyikra shetar hammecher shebbeyado veyachzor biknuneya veyaamod bassade shennitrefa mimmennu veyavo hu shetterafah beatzmah veyitrof otah paam acheret beedut edav veyotzi halla shetar hammecher hashsheni veyitrof bo lakochot acherim shello kaddin. im ken mi shenneevad lo shetar hammecher veedav kayyamin ketzad yaase. yichtevu shetar sheni veyomru bo shetar ze en govin bo lo minnechasim meshubadim velo minnechasim bene chorin velo ketavnuhu ella lehaamid sade zo beyad peloni hallokeach kede shello yotziah miyyado hammocher velo yorshav: 
Beshitre hachovot eno chen. af al pi sheedav kayyamin vekanu miyyado vechazar bishato veamar shetar shekketavtem li atta avad o nisraf en kotvin lo shetar sheni shemma perao o mechalo. vaafillu haya hachov lizman veeno gove beedim ellu kelum ella im hallo omer lo hayu devarim meolam shezze huchzak kafran beedutan kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Mi shebbala shetar chovo vahare hu holech lehimmachek maamid alav edim uva levet din vehem osin lo kiyyum. aval ede hashshetar atzman en kotvin lo shetar acher af al pi shennimchak bifnehem. aval bain levet din uvet din osin lo kiyyum: 
Ketzad mekayyemin shetar ze. kotvin shetar acher veomrim anu bet din peloni ufeloni ufeloni hotzi peloni ben peloni shetar machuk lefanenu uzemanno beyom peloni ufeloni ufeloni edav. veim katvu vehuzkaknu leedutan shel edim venimtzet mechuvvenet gove bishtar ze shekkatvu lo veen tzarich kiyyum acher. veim lo katvu chen tzarich lehavi reaya al haedim harishonim ad shettitkayyem edutan: 
Shetar chov shennitkarea kasher. nimchak o nittashtesh im rishshumo nikkar kasher. nikra kera bet din hare ze pasul. ezehu kera bet din sheti vaerev: 
Mi sheppara miktzat chovo im ratza machlif vechotvin lo bet din shetar acher bishar hachov mizzeman rishon aval lo ede hashshetar. veim ratza yichtov shover: 
Habba lifroa chovo veamar hammalve avad li hashshetar hare ze yichtov lo shover veyifra kol chovo. veyesh lallo lehacharim setam al mi shekkovesh shetaro vetoen sheavad. veim taan hallo taanat vadday veamar hashshetar etzlo veatta hinnicho bechiso horu rabbotay sheyyishshava hammalve hesset sheavad hashshetar veachar kach yifra chovo veyichtov shover: 
Mi shehotzi shetar chov bemane veamar asu li mimmennu shenayim bachamishshim chamishshim en osin shezzechut hu lallo lihyot hakkol bishtar echad sheim yifraennu miktzat nimtza shetaro pagum. vechen im hotzi shene shetarot bachamishshim chamishshim veamar asu li otan bemea en osin lo ella osin lo kiyyum lechol echad veechad shezzechut hu lallo lihyot shenayim shello yachof oto baddin befaam achat ligbot hakkol: 
Hotzi shetar chov bemea veamar kerauhu vechitvu li shetar acher bachamishshim en shomin lo shemma paru hakkol vechatav lo shover al shetar shel mea uchesheyyachazor veyotzi kiyyum ze al shetar chamishshim veyotzi hallo hashshover yomar lo ze shetar acher hu:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 24:
Kevar bearnu sheshshetar chov sheyyesh bo kinyan kotvin oto lallo af al pi sheen hammalve immo. vechen kotvin shetar lammocher af al pi sheen hallokeach immo. vechen kotvin shover lammalve af al pi sheen hallo immo veshover leishsha af al pi sheen balah immah veget leish af al pi sheen ishto immo. aval en kotvin shitre erusin venissuin veshitre arisut vekabbelanut ushetar bererat haddayyanin o shetar taanat baale dinin vechol maase bet din ella middaat shenehem. vechol hashshetarot haellu tzerichin lehizzaher betikkunan kishar hashshetarot: 
Umi noten sechar hassofer. beshitre halevaa hallo noten sachar. uveshitre mikkach umimkar hallokeach noten sachar. vehaishsha notenet sechar hagget. vehechatan noten sechar shetar haerusin o hannissuin. vehamekabbel vechen haaris o hassachir noten sechar hashshetar. aval shetar bererat haddayyanin o taanot baale dinin shenehem notnin sachar: 
Echad hashshetarot hannichtavin leechad shello bifne chavero veechad hashshetarot sheen kotvin otan ella middaat shenehem ushenehen omdin kegon shetar shekkotvin lammalve o lallokeach kullan tzerichin sheyyihyu haedim makkirin hashshemot shobbashshetar shezze hu peloni ben peloni vezehu peloni ben peloni shemma yavou shenayim veyaasu kenuneya vishannu shemotehen beshemot acherim veyodu ze laze: 
Kol mi shehuchzak shemo bair sheloshim yom en choshshin lo shemma shem acher yesh lo vehu shinnahu kede lerammot velaasot kenuneya sheim atta omer ken en laddavar sof. lefichach mi shello huchzak shemo bair sheloshim yom uva veamar kitvu alay shetar sheani chayyav lifloni o laze kach vechach dinarin. en kotvin lo ad sheyyavi reaya shezze shemo o yuchzak: 
Kol shetar sheyyatza lefanenu veyiton hallo veyomar eni chayyav kelum shemma rammay acher heela shemo kishmi vehoda laze o sheamar lo laze ani chayyav kelum ella leacher veze rammay hu veheela shemo keshem baal chovi. meachar shello huchzak sham shenayim sheshshemotehen shavin en choshshin lidvarav shechazaka hu sheen haedim chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken makkirin ellu hannizkarim bo. vechen chazaka sheen chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken noda lahem bevadday shaalu sheheidu al atzman gedolim uvene daat. veen haedim chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken yodim likrot velachtom: 
Edim sheen yodin lachtom vekaru lahen neyar chalak vechatmu al harashum makkin otan makkat mardut vehashshetar pasul: 
Rosh bet din shehaya yodea inyan hashshetar vekara hashshetar shellefanav hassofer shello hoil vehu maamin oto veemato alav hare ze chotem al hashshetar af al pi shello keraahu hu beatzmo. veen shear haam rashshain laasot ken ad sheyyikra haed hashshetar milla milla: 
Shenayim shehayu bair shem kol echad mehen yosef ben shimon enan yecholin lehotzi shetar chov ze al ze velo acher yachol lehotzi alehen shetar chov ella im ken bau ede hashshetar beatzman veamru zehu hashshetar sheheadnu alav vezehu sheheadnu lo behalevaa. vechen en megarshin neshotehen ella ze bifne ze. vechen im nimtza leechad ben shitrotav shover sheshshetaro shel yosef ben shimon parua shitrot shenehen shealav peruin. vechetzad yaasu ellu sheshshemotehen shavin ushemot avihen shavin. yeshalleshu. hayu shemot avot avotehen shavin yichtevu simanehen. hayu domin ze laze betzuratan yichtevu yichusan. hayu shenehem leviyyim shenehem kohanim yichtevu dorot: 
Hotzi alav shetar shekkatuv bo ani peloni ben peloni laviti mimmecha mane af al pi sheen bo shem hammalve kol mi sheyyatza shetar ze mittachat yado gove bo veeno yachol lidchoto velomar shel acher hu venafal. vechen shene yosef bene shimon haddarin beir achat shehotzi echad mehen shetar chov al echad mibbene hair eno yachol lidchoto velomar lo lifloni shehu keshimcha ani chayyav umimmennu nafal hashshetar ella hare ze sheyyatza mittachat yado gove veen choshshin linfila: 
Shenayim shehotziu kol echad mishshenehem shetar chov al chavero en haacharon yachol lomar larishon illu hayiti chayyav lecha heach atta lo mimmenni ella ze gove chovo veze gove chovo. haya ze bemea veze bemea veyesh laze idit velaze idit o laze benonit velaze benonit laze zibburit velaze zibburit en nizkakin lahen ella kol echad veechad omed beshello. haya laze idit uvenonit velaze zibburit ze gove min habbenonit veze gove min hazzibburit: 
Hotzi shetar chov al chavero vehalla motzi shetar shemmachar lo hassade im hayu bemakom shennoten hallokeach hammaot veachar kach kotev lo hammocher et hashshetar hare shetar chovo shel ze batel shehare omer lo illu hayiti chayyav lecha haya lecha lifroa chovcha. aval bemakom shekkotvin veachar kach notnin hare shetar hachov kayyam shehare ze omer macharti lecha et hassade kede sheyyihye lecha nechasim yeduim sheegbe mehen chov shelli:
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 25:
Hammalve et chavero veachar shehilvahu amar lo echad ani arev. o shettava et hallo baddin veamar lo acher hannach vaani arev. o shehaya chonek et chavero bashshuk litten lo veamar lo hannach vaani arev. en hearev chayyav kelum. vaafillu amar ani arev bifne bet din. aval im kanu miyyado shehu arev mamon ze kol ellu happanim ben bifne bet din ben beno leven hammalve nishtabed: 
Amar lo bishat mattan maot halevehu vaani arev nishtabed hearev veeno tzarich kinyan. vechen im bet din asu oto arev nishtabed af al pi shello kanu miyyado. kegon shehayu bet din rotzin ligbot min hallo veamar lahem hannichuhu vaani arev lachem hoil veyesh lo hanaa sheheeminuhu bet din beotah hanaya shibed atzmo: 
Hammalve et chavero al yede arev af al pi shehearev mishtabed lammalve lo yitba et hearev techilla ella tovea et hallo techilla. im lo natan lo chozer etzel hearev venifra mimmennu. bamme devarim amurim besheen nechasim lallo. aval im yesh nechasim lallo lo yippara min hearev kelal ella min hallo. haya hallo allam veen bet din yecholin lehotzi miyyado o shello ba laddin hare ze nifra min hearev techilla veachar kach yaase hearev din im hallo im yachol lehotzio miyyado yotzi o yeshammetuhu bet din ad sheyyitten lo: 
Hitna hammalve al hearev veamar lo al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze im yesh nechasim lallo lo yippara min hearev. amar al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze techilla o shehaya kabbelan hare ze yitba et hearev hazze o et hakkabbelan techilla veyippara mehen af al pi sheyyesh nechasim lallo: 
Ezehu arev veezehu kabbelan. amar lo ten lo vaani noten lecha zehu kabbelan sheyyesh lammalve lehippara mimmennu techilla af al pi shello peresh velo amar al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze. aval im amar lo halevehu vaani arev halevehu vaani porea halevehu vaani chayyav halevehu vaani noten halevehu vaani kabbelan. ten lo vaani kabbelan ten lo vaani porea ten lo vaani chayyav ten lo vaani arev. kullan lashon arvanut hen veeno tovo techilla velo nifra mimmennu bemakom sheyyesh nechasim lallo ad sheyyefaresh veyomar mimmi sheertze eppara: 
Arev shel ketubba af al pi shekkanu miyyado patur milleshallem shehare mitzva asa velo chasar mamon. veim haya haav arev lichtubbat beno vekanu miyyado chayyav. vekabbelan shel ketubba chayyav: 
Reuven shemmachar leshimon sade uva levi vekibbel acharayut alav lo nishtabed levi shezzo asmachta hi. veim kanu miyyado shehu arev leshallem deme mecher ze kol et sheyyirtze sheyyitbaennu leshimon hare ze chayyav vechaze horu rabbotay:
